title: ProofTools — Representatives, extensions and comparison laws

blocks.tex: Fix a model $D$ of the classical and synthetic Adams systems. All maps, quotient objects, filtrations and page labels in each statement are taken in this model. In the statements quoted from \cite{LWX126}, spectra are $2$-completed, connective and of finite type.

blocks.label: sem:ProofTools:common-labels
blocks.title: Common cycle, boundary and permanent labels
blocks.body: For a classical spectrum $X$, a common label in bidegree $(s,t)$ is an element of $E_2^{s,t}(X)$. For $c\geq1$, it is a level-$c$ cycle, respectively boundary, if it lies in $Z_c^{s,t}(X)$, respectively $B_c^{s,t}(X)$. A permanent label is an element of $Z_\infty^{s,t}(X)$; the zero label is included.

blocks.label: sem:ProofTools:congruence-and-differential
blocks.title: Congruence and differential equations
blocks.body: For $c\geq1$, labels $x,y\in E_2^{s,t}(X)$ are congruent at level $c$ if $x-y\in B_c^{s,t}(X)$. For $r\geq2$, the equation $d_r(x)=y$ means that $x$ and $y$ represent classes on page $r$ and their classes satisfy the Adams differential equation, with source bidegree $(s,t)$ and target bidegree $(s+r,t+r-1)$. The target may be zero.

blocks.label: sem:ProofTools:cycle-reaches
blocks.title: Cycles and representatives on later pages
blocks.body: For $r\geq2$, a common label lies in $Z_{r-1}$ if and only if it reaches page $r$. If $x$ represents $x_r$ on page $r$ and $y-x\in B_{r-1}$, then $y$ represents $x_r$. If $d_r(x)=y$ and $y'-y\in B_{r-1}$, then $d_r(x)=y'$.

lean.name: KIP126.ProofTools.differentialAt_of_congruent
lean.code:
public theorem differentialAt_of_congruent (X : ClassicalObject) {R : ℤ}
    {p q : ℤ × ℤ} {x : Ambient D X p} {y z : Ambient D X q}
    (hd : DifferentialAt D X R p q x y)
    (hz : Congruent D X (R - 1) q z y) :
    DifferentialAt D X R p q x z := by
  obtain ⟨hR, hdeg, xr, yr, hx, hy, hdiff⟩ := hd
  exact ⟨hR, hdeg, xr, yr, hx, representsOnPage_of_congruent D X hR hy hz, hdiff⟩

lean.name: KIP126.ProofTools.isCycle_iff_reaches
lean.code:
public theorem isCycle_iff_reaches (X : ClassicalObject) (r : ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (p : ℤ × ℤ)
    (x : Ambient D X p) :
    IsCycle D X (r-1) p x ↔ ReachesPage (D.classical.obj (X.obj D.auxiliary)) r p x := by
  let E := D.classical.obj (X.obj D.auxiliary)
  let P := E.ssData p
  let m : WithTop ℕ := ↑(r-E.r₀).toNat
  have hm : (↑(r-1-1).toNat : WithTop ℕ) = m := by
    dsimp only [m, E]
    rw [D.classical.firstPage]
    congr 2; omega
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, hx⟩
    change ∃ z, KIP126.Literature.cycleLabel D X (↑(r-1-1).toNat) p z = x at hx
    rw [hm] at hx
    obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨P.pageπ m z, hr, z, ?_, rfl⟩
    change (Subobject.ofLE (P.Z m) (P.Z _) _ ≫ P.pageπ _) z = x
    rw [initialProjection_eq_cycleLabel D X r hr p]
    exact hz
  · rintro ⟨y, _, z, hz, _⟩
    refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
    change ∃ z, KIP126.Literature.cycleLabel D X (↑(r-1-1).toNat) p z = x
    rw [hm]
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    rw [initialProjection_eq_cycleLabel D X r hr p] at hz
    exact hz

lean.name: KIP126.ProofTools.representsOnPage_of_congruent
lean.code:
public theorem representsOnPage_of_congruent (X : ClassicalObject) {R : ℤ}
    (hR : 2 ≤ R) {p : ℤ × ℤ} {x y : Ambient D X p}
    {xr : (D.classical.obj (X.obj D.auxiliary)).Page R p}
    (hx : RepresentsOnPage (D.classical.obj (X.obj D.auxiliary)) R p x xr)
    (hy : Congruent D X (R - 1) p y x) :
    RepresentsOnPage (D.classical.obj (X.obj D.auxiliary)) R p y xr := by
  let E := D.classical.obj (X.obj D.auxiliary)
  let P := E.ssData p
  let k : WithTop ℕ := ↑(R - E.r₀).toNat
  obtain ⟨_, z, hzx, hzr⟩ := hx
  have hb : y - x ∈ KIP126.Literature.boundaries D X (R - 1) p := hy.2
  change ∃ b, KIP126.Literature.boundaryLabel D X (↑(R - 1 - 1).toNat) p b = y - x at hb
  have hk : (↑(R-1-1).toNat : WithTop ℕ) = k := by
    dsimp only [k,E]
    rw [D.classical.firstPage]
    congr 2; omega
  rw [hk] at hb
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hb
  let j := Subobject.ofLE (P.B k) (P.Z k) (P.B_le_Z k)
  have hlabel : j ≫ KIP126.Literature.cycleLabel D X k p =
      KIP126.Literature.boundaryLabel D X k p := by
    dsimp only [j, KIP126.Literature.cycleLabel, KIP126.Literature.boundaryLabel, P, E]
    simp only [← Category.assoc, Subobject.ofLE_comp_ofLE]
  have hboundary : (P.pageπ k) (j b) = 0 := by
    have hj : j ≫ P.pageπ k = 0 := cokernel.condition _
    exact congrArg (fun f => f b) hj
  refine ⟨hR, z + j b, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hz0 : KIP126.Literature.cycleLabel D X k p z = x := by
      rw [initialProjection_eq_cycleLabel D X R hR p] at hzx
      exact hzx
    have hzb : KIP126.Literature.cycleLabel D X k p (j b) = y - x := by
      change (j ≫ KIP126.Literature.cycleLabel D X k p) b = _
      rw [hlabel]
      exact hb
    have hh : KIP126.Literature.cycleLabel D X k p (z + j b) = y := by
      rw [map_add, hz0, hzb]
      abel
    change (Subobject.ofLE (P.Z k) (P.Z _) _ ≫ P.pageπ _) (z+j b) = y
    rw [initialProjection_eq_cycleLabel D X R hR p]
    exact hh
  · change P.pageπ k (z + j b) = xr
    rw [map_add, hboundary, add_zero]
    exact hzr

blocks.label: sem:ProofTools:boundary-calculus
blocks.title: Boundary and cycle calculus
blocks.body: For $c\geq1$, $B_c\subseteq Z_c$, and $B_1=0$. If a common label represents zero on page $r\geq2$, it lies in $B_{r-1}$. Projection of a common cycle to the initial page recovers its $E_2$-label.

blocks.label: sem:ProofTools:finite-correction
blocks.title: Finite correction of a residual
blocks.body:
Let $A,A',B$ be abelian groups, $N\in\mathbb N$, and $\rho:A'\to A$ and $g:A\to B$ homomorphisms, let $E_k\leq A$, $L_k\leq A'$ with $L$ decreasing, and let $T\leq B$. Suppose that for each $s\leq k<s+N$, a residual $\delta\in E_k$ can either be corrected by some $\varepsilon\in L_k$ so that $\delta-\rho\varepsilon\in E_{k+1}$, or already satisfies $g\delta\in T$. Suppose also that $g(E_{s+N})\subseteq T$. If $\alpha_0-\rho\alpha\in E_s$, there is $\alpha'$ with
\[\alpha'-\alpha\in L_s,\qquad g(\alpha_0-\rho\alpha')\in T.\]

lean.name: KIP126.ProofTools.finite_filtration_correction
lean.code:
public theorem finite_filtration_correction
    {A A' B : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup A'] [AddCommGroup B]
    (ρ : A' →+ A) (g : A →+ B)
    (E : ℤ → AddSubgroup A) (L : ℤ → AddSubgroup A')
    (T : AddSubgroup B) (hL : Antitone L)
    (s : ℤ) (N : ℕ)
    (hstep : ∀ k : ℤ, s ≤ k → k < s + N → ∀ δ : A, δ ∈ E k →
      (∃ ε : A', ε ∈ L k ∧ δ - ρ ε ∈ E (k + 1)) ∨ g δ ∈ T)
    (hend : ∀ δ : A, δ ∈ E (s + N) → g δ ∈ T)
    (α₀ : A) (α : A') (hδ : α₀ - ρ α ∈ E s) :
    ∃ α' : A', α' - α ∈ L s ∧ g (α₀ - ρ α') ∈ T := by
  induction N generalizing s α with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨α, ?_, hend _ ?_⟩
    · simpa only [sub_self] using (L s).zero_mem
    · simpa only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero] using hδ
  | succ N ih =>
    rcases hstep s le_rfl (by omega) _ hδ with hcorrect | hstop
    · obtain ⟨ε, hε, hδε⟩ := hcorrect
      have hδ' : α₀ - ρ (α + ε) ∈ E (s + 1) := by
        simpa only [map_add, sub_add_eq_sub_sub] using hδε
      obtain ⟨α', hα', hfinal⟩ := ih (s + 1)
        (fun k hk hkn δ hδ => hstep k (by omega) (by omega) δ hδ)
        (fun δ hδ => hend δ (by simpa only [Nat.cast_succ, add_assoc,
          add_comm, add_left_comm] using hδ)) (α + ε) hδ'
      refine ⟨α', ?_, hfinal⟩
      have hmem := (L s).add_mem (hL (by omega) hα') hε
      convert hmem using 1
      abel
    · exact ⟨α, by simpa only [sub_self] using (L s).zero_mem, hstop⟩
lean.statement:
public theorem finite_filtration_correction
    {A A' B : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup A'] [AddCommGroup B]
    (ρ : A' →+ A) (g : A →+ B)
    (E : ℤ → AddSubgroup A) (L : ℤ → AddSubgroup A')
    (T : AddSubgroup B) (hL : Antitone L)
    (s : ℤ) (N : ℕ)
    (hstep : ∀ k : ℤ, s ≤ k → k < s + N → ∀ δ : A, δ ∈ E k →
      (∃ ε : A', ε ∈ L k ∧ δ - ρ ε ∈ E (k + 1)) ∨ g δ ∈ T)
    (hend : ∀ δ : A, δ ∈ E (s + N) → g δ ∈ T)
    (α₀ : A) (α : A') (hδ : α₀ - ρ α ∈ E s) :
    ∃ α' : A', α' - α ∈ L s ∧ g (α₀ - ρ α') ∈ T
lean.docstring: A finite correction argument with the actual residual kept throughout.

blocks.label: sem:ProofTools:finite-reflection
blocks.title: Reflection along a finite filtration interval
blocks.body: Let $B',B$ be abelian groups, $N\in\mathbb N$, and $\rho:B'\to B$ a homomorphism. Let $E$ be a decreasing filtration on $B$, and let $L_k\leq B'$. Suppose that for $s\leq k<s+N$, $b\in L_k$ and $\rho b\in E_{k+1}$ imply $b\in L_{k+1}$. Then $b\in L_s$ and $\rho b\in E_{s+N}$ imply $b\in L_{s+N}$.

lean.name: KIP126.ProofTools.finite_filtration_reflection
lean.code:
public theorem finite_filtration_reflection
    {B' B : Type*} [AddCommGroup B'] [AddCommGroup B]
    (ρ : B' →+ B) (L : ℤ → AddSubgroup B') (E : ℤ → AddSubgroup B)
    (hE : Antitone E) (s : ℤ) (N : ℕ)
    (hgraded : ∀ k : ℤ, s ≤ k → k < s + N → ∀ b : B', b ∈ L k →
      ρ b ∈ E (k + 1) → b ∈ L (k + 1))
    (b : B') (hb : b ∈ L s) (hρb : ρ b ∈ E (s + N)) :
    b ∈ L (s + N) := by
  have h : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ N → b ∈ L (s + k) := by
    intro k hk
    induction k with
    | zero => simpa only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero] using hb
    | succ k ih =>
      have hkN : k ≤ N := by omega
      have hnext := hgraded (s + k) (by omega) (by omega) b (ih hkN)
        (hE (by omega) hρb)
      simpa only [Nat.cast_succ, add_assoc] using hnext
  exact h N le_rfl
lean.statement:
public theorem finite_filtration_reflection
    {B' B : Type*} [AddCommGroup B'] [AddCommGroup B]
    (ρ : B' →+ B) (L : ℤ → AddSubgroup B') (E : ℤ → AddSubgroup B)
    (hE : Antitone E) (s : ℤ) (N : ℕ)
    (hgraded : ∀ k : ℤ, s ≤ k → k < s + N → ∀ b : B', b ∈ L k →
      ρ b ∈ E (k + 1) → b ∈ L (k + 1))
    (b : B') (hb : b ∈ L s) (hρb : ρ b ∈ E (s + N)) :
    b ∈ L (s + N)
lean.docstring:
Injectivity of successive graded maps reflects membership through a finite
filtration interval; it does not require injectivity of the ambient map.

blocks.label: sem:ProofTools:leading-grade
blocks.title: The first nonzero grade in a finite interval
blocks.body:
Let $E_k$ be subgroups of an abelian group and let $N\in\mathbb N$. If $b\in E_s$ but $b\notin E_{s+N}$, then there exists $s\leq k<s+N$ with
\[b\in E_k\quad\text{and}\quad b\notin E_{k+1}.\]

lean.name: KIP126.ProofTools.first_nonzero_filtration_grade
lean.code:
public theorem first_nonzero_filtration_grade
    {B : Type*} [AddCommGroup B] (E : ℤ → AddSubgroup B)
    (s : ℤ) (N : ℕ) (b : B) (hb : b ∈ E s) (hnot : b ∉ E (s + N)) :
    ∃ k : ℤ, s ≤ k ∧ k < s + N ∧ b ∈ E k ∧ b ∉ E (k + 1) := by
  induction N generalizing s with
  | zero => exact (hnot (by simpa only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero] using hb)).elim
  | succ N ih =>
    by_cases hnext : b ∈ E (s + 1)
    · have hnot' : b ∉ E ((s + 1) + N) := by
        simpa only [Nat.cast_succ, add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm] using hnot
      obtain ⟨k, hk, hkN, hb, hnot⟩ := ih (s + 1) hnext hnot'
      exact ⟨k, by omega, by omega, hb, hnot⟩
    · exact ⟨s, le_rfl, by omega, hb, hnext⟩
lean.statement:
public theorem first_nonzero_filtration_grade
    {B : Type*} [AddCommGroup B] (E : ℤ → AddSubgroup B)
    (s : ℤ) (N : ℕ) (b : B) (hb : b ∈ E s) (hnot : b ∉ E (s + N)) :
    ∃ k : ℤ, s ≤ k ∧ k < s + N ∧ b ∈ E k ∧ b ∉ E (k + 1)
lean.docstring:
Failure to lie in the final layer is witnessed by a nonzero leading grade
in the finite interval.

blocks.label: sem:ProofTools:extension-representatives
blocks.title: Representatives for a tower extension equation
blocks.body:
Let $g:X\to Y$ be a map of convergent towers. Fix $(m,w)$ and classes $x\in E_\infty^{s,m+s,w}(X)$ and $y\in E_\infty^{s+n,m+s+n,w}(Y)$. An extension equation of length $n$ from $x$ to $y$ holds if and only if $n\geq0$ and there are representatives
\[a\in F^s\pi_{m,w}X,\qquad b\in F^{s+n}\pi_{m,w}Y,\qquad g_*(a)=b\]
whose associated-graded classes correspond to $x$ and $y$ under the convergence isomorphisms.

lean.name: KIP126.ProofTools.Operations.tower_extension_iff
lean.code:
public theorem tower_extension_iff
    {Syn : Type u} [SyntheticCategory.{u,v} Syn]
    [KIP126.StableHomotopy.HasFunctorialCofiber (C := Syn)]
    {H : Syn} {unit : S_0_0 ⟶ H} {F : SyntheticAdamsFamily Syn}
    {P : SyntheticTowerPresentation unit F} {X Y : Syn} {g : X ⟶ Y}
    {cx : SyntheticTowerConvergence P X} {cy : SyntheticTowerConvergence P Y}
    (M : ConvergentMap F g cx.toConvergence cy.toConvergence)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s n : ℤ)
    (x : ((F.obj X).sequence.ssData (s,p.1+s,p.2)).eInfty)
    (y : ((F.obj Y).sequence.ssData (s+n,p.1+(s+n),p.2)).eInfty) :
    TowerExtensionEquation M p s n x y ↔
      0 ≤ n ∧ ∃ (a : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration X).F s p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
        (b : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ)),
        ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow a ≫ g = ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p).arrow b ∧
        (P.filtration X).toAssociatedGraded s p a = (infinityGradedIso cx p s).hom x ∧
        (P.filtration Y).toAssociatedGraded (s+n) p b = (infinityGradedIso cy p (s+n)).hom y :=
  Internal.tower_extension_iff M p s n x y

blocks.label: sem:ProofTools:grade-naturality
blocks.title: Naturality and the next-filtration ambiguity
blocks.body:
Let $g:X\to Y$ be a map of convergent towers, $a\in F^s\pi_{m,w}X$ and $b\in F^s\pi_{m,w}Y$. If $g_*(a)=b$, their associated-graded classes satisfy $g_\infty([a])=[b]$. Conversely, this graded equality implies
\[b-g_*(a)\in F^{s+1}\pi_{m,w}Y.\]
If $g_\infty$ is injective in this degree and $g_*(a)\in F^{s+1}\pi_{m,w}Y$, then $a\in F^{s+1}\pi_{m,w}X$.

blocks.title: Transport and reflection of detection
blocks.body: Let $g:X\to Y$ be a map of convergent towers. If $x$ detects $\alpha$ on $X$, then $g_2(x)$ detects $g_*(\alpha)$ on $Y$. Conversely, suppose that $g_\infty$ is injective in filtration $s$, that $x$ represents an infinite-page class, and that $\alpha\in F^s\pi_{m,w}X$. If $g_2(x)$ detects $g_*(\alpha)$, then $x$ detects $\alpha$.

blocks.title: Finite target labels
blocks.body:
For $q>0$ and $0\leq k<q$, let $y\in Z_{q-k}^{s,t}(X)$. Its finite target label at weight $t-k$ represents $e\in E_\infty^{s,t,t-k}(\nu X/\lambda^q)$ if and only if the finite-window comparison carries $e$ to the class of $y$ in
\[Z_{q-k}^{s,t}(X)/B_{1+k}^{s,t}(X).\]

blocks.label: sem:ProofTools:shift-coherence
blocks.title: Suspension and composition coherence
blocks.body:
Assume that suspension and bigraded shifts are coherent with the homotopy functors. The canonical isomorphism
\[\Sigma^{1,-q}Q\cong\Sigma(\Sigma^{0,-q}Q)\]
identifies the induced suspension and bigraded-shift maps. The inverse and composition isomorphisms for shifts induce the corresponding inverse and composition maps on homotopy groups.

blocks.label: sem:ProofTools:leibniz-law
blocks.title: The generalized Leibniz law
blocks.body:
Let $f:X\to Y$ and write $e=e(f)$. The generalized Leibniz law is the following implication. Assume $2\leq p\leq r$, $e\leq m\leq p-2+e$, $e\leq l$, and
\[x\in Z_{r-1}^{s,t}(X),\qquad y\in Z_{r-1-m+e}^{s+m,t+m}(Y),\]
\[x_\infty\in Z_\infty^{s+r,t+r-1}(X),\qquad y_\infty\in Z_\infty^{s+r+l,t+r+l-1}(Y).\]
Suppose that
\[d_r(x)=x_\infty,\qquad d_m^{f,E_p}(x)=y,\qquad d_l^{f,E_\infty}(x_\infty)=y_\infty.\]
Assume either that the first differential has no crossing on page $p$ or that the finite extension has no crossing, and assume that the infinite extension has no crossing. Then
\[d_{r+l-m}(y)=y_\infty.\]

lean.name: KIP126.ProofTools.GeneralizedLeibnizLaw
lean.code:
public def GeneralizedLeibnizLaw (X Y : ClassicalObject) (f : X.obj D.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj D.auxiliary) : Prop :=
  ∀ (page : ℕ) (r m l s t : ℤ)
    (x : Ambient D X (s, t)) (y : Ambient D Y (s + m, t + m))
    (xInfinity : Ambient D X (s + r, t + r - 1))
    (yInfinity : Ambient D Y (s + r + l, t + r - 1 + l)),
    2 ≤ page → (page : ℤ) ≤ r →
    (normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f : ℤ) ≤ m →
    m ≤ (page : ℤ) - 2 + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f →
    (normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f : ℤ) ≤ l →
    IsCycle D X (r - 1) (s, t) x →
    IsCycle D Y (r - 1 - m + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f) (s + m, t + m) y →
    IsPermanent D X (s + r, t + r - 1) xInfinity →
    IsPermanent D Y (s + r + l, t + r - 1 + l) yInfinity →
    DifferentialAt D X r (s, t) (s + r, t + r - 1) x xInfinity →
    FiniteExtension D X Y f page m s t x y →
    InfiniteExtension D X Y f l (s + r) (t + r - 1) xInfinity yInfinity →
    (NoCrossingOn D X r page (s, t) ∨
      FiniteNoCrossing D X Y f page m s t) →
    InfiniteNoCrossing D X Y f l (s + r) (t + r - 1) →
    DifferentialAt D Y (r + l - m) (s + m, t + m)
      (s + r + l, t + r - 1 + l) y yInfinity

blocks.label: sem:ProofTools:mahowald-law
blocks.title: The normalized-triangle Mahowald law
blocks.body:
Let $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ\xrightarrow h\Sigma X$ be a distinguished triangle with $e(f)+e(g)+e(h)=1$, whose normalized synthetic maps form a compatible triangle. Put
\[n_1=n-e(f)\geq1,\quad m_1=m-e(g)\geq0,\quad l_1=l-e(h)\geq0,\quad r=n+m+l,\quad r'=r-m_1.\]
The normalized-triangle Mahowald law is the following implication. Suppose
\[x\in Z_{n_1}^{s+l,t+l-1}(X),\quad y\in Z_{m_1+1}^{s+l+n,t+l+n-1}(Y),\]
\[\bar x\in Z_{r-1}^{s,t}(Z),\qquad\bar y\in Z_\infty^{s+r,t+r-1}(Z).\]
Let $\widetilde x\in E_2^{s+l,t+l}(\Sigma X)$ desuspend to $x$ under the tower suspension comparison, and assume
\[d_l^{h,E_{r'}}(\bar x)=\widetilde x,\qquad d_r(\bar x)=\bar y,\qquad d_m^{g,E_{m_1+2}}(y)=\bar y.\]
Assume that the $h$-extension has no crossing or that the classical differential has no crossing on page $r'$. Then $x\in Z_{n+m+e(h)}^{s+l,t+l-1}(X)$ and there is $y'$ such that
\[d_n^{f,E_{n+m+1+e(h)}}(x)=y',\qquad y'-y\in B_{r'}^{s+l+n,t+l+n-1}(Y).\]

lean.name: KIP126.ProofTools.GeneralizedMahowaldLaw
lean.code:
public def GeneralizedMahowaldLaw (T : TriangleData D.auxiliary) : Prop :=
  ∀ he : (normalizedExponent D.classicalTower T.f : ℤ) + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower T.g +
      normalizedExponent D.classicalTower T.h = 1,
  KIP126.Literature.NormalizedTriangleCompatible D T he →
  ∀ (n m l s t : ℤ),
    let r := n + m + l
    let n₁ := n - normalizedExponent D.classicalTower T.f
    let m₁ := m - normalizedExponent D.classicalTower T.g
    let l₁ := l - normalizedExponent D.classicalTower T.h
    let r' := r - m₁
    ∀ (x : Ambient D (T.X) (s + l, t + l - 1))
      (y : Ambient D (T.Y) (s + l + n, t + l - 1 + n))
      (xBar : Ambient D (T.Z) (s, t))
      (yBar : Ambient D (T.Z) (s + l + n + m, t + l - 1 + n + m))
      (suspendedX : Ambient D (.shift 1 T.X) (s + l, t + l)),
      1 ≤ n₁ → 0 ≤ m₁ → 0 ≤ l₁ →
      IsCycle D (T.X) n₁ (s + l, t + l - 1) x →
      IsCycle D (T.Y) (m₁ + 1) (s + l + n, t + l - 1 + n) y →
      IsCycle D (T.Z) (r - 1) (s, t) xBar →
      IsPermanent D (T.Z) (s + l + n + m, t + l - 1 + n + m) yBar →
      (D.classicalSuspension T.X).DesuspendsClass (s + l) (t + l) suspendedX x →
      FiniteExtension D T.Z (.shift 1 T.X) T.h r'.toNat l s t xBar suspendedX →
      DifferentialAt D (T.Z) r (s, t)
        (s + l + n + m, t + l - 1 + n + m) xBar yBar →
      (FiniteNoCrossing D T.Z (.shift 1 T.X) T.h r'.toNat l s t ∨
        NoCrossingOn D (T.Z) r r' (s, t)) →
      FiniteExtension D T.Y T.Z T.g (m₁ + 2).toNat m (s + l + n) (t + l - 1 + n) y yBar →
      IsCycle D (T.X) (n + m + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower T.h) (s + l, t + l - 1) x ∧
        ∃ y' : Ambient D (T.Y) (s + l + n, t + l - 1 + n),
          FiniteExtension D T.X T.Y T.f (n + m + 1 + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower T.h).toNat
            n (s + l) (t + l - 1) x y' ∧
          Congruent D (T.Y) r' (s + l + n, t + l - 1 + n) y' y

blocks.label: sem:ProofTools:nonliftable-obstruction
blocks.title: The same-quotient nonliftable obstruction
blocks.body:
Let $r_{\rm early}\leq r_{\rm late}$. A nonliftable obstruction is an extension of length $n-a-b$ for the normalized map in the $(r_{\rm early}-1)$-st quotient, in stem $t-s$ and weight $t+e(f)$, where
\[a,b\in\mathbb N,\qquad 0<a\leq r_{\rm early}-2,\qquad a+b\leq n.\]
Its source has filtration $s+a$ and lies outside the image of quotient reduction from the $(r_{\rm late}-1)$-st quotient on $E_\infty$; its target has filtration $s+n-b$ and is nonzero. The extension may be inessential.

lean.name: KIP126.ProofTools.FiniteExtensionNonliftableCrossing
lean.code:
public def FiniteExtensionNonliftableCrossing
    (rEarlier rLater : ℕ) (n s t : ℤ) : Prop :=
  ∃ hle : rEarlier ≤ rLater, ∃ a b : ℕ,
    0 < a ∧ a ≤ rEarlier - 2 ∧ (a : ℤ) + b ≤ n ∧
    ∃ (source : ((D.family.obj ((SyntheticObject.quotient (rEarlier - 1)
          (extensionSourceObject D X Y f)).obj D.nu D.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData
          (s + a, (t - s) + (s + a), t + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f)).eInfty)
      (target : ((D.family.obj ((SyntheticObject.quotient (rEarlier - 1)
          (.nu Y)).obj D.nu D.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData
          (s + a + (n - a - b), (t - s) + (s + a + (n - a - b)),
            t + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f)).eInfty),
      source ∉ Set.range (((D.family.functor.map
        ((D.quotients.tower ((extensionSourceObject D X Y f).obj D.nu D.auxiliary)).rho
          (rEarlier - 1) (rLater - 1) (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hle 1))).eInftyMap
            (s + a, (t - s) + (s + a), t + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f)).hom) ∧
      TowerExtensionEquation (D.convergentMap
        (.quotient (rEarlier - 1) (extensionSourceObject D X Y f))
        (.quotient (rEarlier - 1) (.nu Y))
        (finiteExtensionMap D X Y f (rEarlier - 1)))
        (t - s, t + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f) (s + a) (n - a - b) source target ∧
      target ≠ 0

lean.docstring:
有限 stretching 的障碍候选，直接在同一个早期 λ 商的实际 ESS 中定义。
源和靶的 synthetic weight 固定为原 extension 的 `t + e(f)`，而源的
filtration 提高 `a`。源必须不在后期商到早期商的实际 `ρ` 所诱导的
`E∞` 映射像中；这与某个普通 Adams 代表元不属于后页 cycle 层不同。
允许 `b = 0` 及长度 `n - a - b = 0` 的 synthetic extension，包括
`e(f) = 1` 的情形。要求同商中实际 extension equation 的靶非零，不要求
essential 性，不换成较小 λ 商的 extension，也不额外施加普通 Adams
boundary 排除条件。排除这些候选强于仅排除 essential crossings；这是
修复后的充分条件，不声称与原普通 Adams 代表元谓词等价。

blocks.label: sem:ProofTools:finite-stretching-law
blocks.title: The finite stretching sufficient condition
blocks.body:
Suppose $2\leq r_{\rm early}\leq r_{\rm late}$ and
\[e(f)\leq n\leq r_{\rm early}-2+e(f).\]
The finite stretching law is the following implication: if
\[x\in Z_{r_{\rm late}-1}^{s,t}(X),\qquad y\in Z_{r_{\rm late}-1-n+e(f)}^{s+n,t+n}(Y),\qquad d_n^{f,E_{r_{\rm early}}}(x)=y,\]
and there is no nonliftable obstruction as above, then
\[d_n^{f,E_{r_{\rm late}}}(x)=y.\]

lean.name: KIP126.ProofTools.FinitePageExtensionStretchingLaw
lean.code:
public def FinitePageExtensionStretchingLaw (X Y : ClassicalObject) (f : X.obj D.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj D.auxiliary) : Prop :=
  ∀ (rEarlier rLater : ℕ) (n s t : ℤ)
    (x : Ambient D X (s, t)) (y : Ambient D Y (s + n, t + n)),
    2 ≤ rEarlier → rEarlier ≤ rLater →
    (normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f : ℤ) ≤ n →
    n ≤ (rEarlier : ℤ) - 2 + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f →
    IsCycle D X ((rLater : ℤ) - 1) (s, t) x →
    IsCycle D Y ((rLater : ℤ) - 1 - n + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f) (s + n, t + n) y →
    FiniteExtension D X Y f rEarlier n s t x y →
    ¬ FiniteExtensionNonliftableCrossing D X Y f rEarlier rLater n s t →
    FiniteExtension D X Y f rLater n s t x y
lean.statement:
public def FinitePageExtensionStretchingLaw (X Y : ClassicalObject) (f : X.obj D.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj D.auxiliary) : Prop :=
  ∀ (rEarlier rLater : ℕ) (n s t : ℤ)
    (x : Ambient D X (s, t)) (y : Ambient D Y (s + n, t + n)),
    2 ≤ rEarlier → rEarlier ≤ rLater →
    (normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f : ℤ) ≤ n →
    n ≤ (rEarlier : ℤ) - 2 + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f →
    IsCycle D X ((rLater : ℤ) - 1) (s, t) x →
    IsCycle D Y ((rLater : ℤ) - 1 - n + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f) (s + n, t + n) y →
    FiniteExtension D X Y f rEarlier n s t x y →
    ¬ FiniteExtensionNonliftableCrossing D X Y f rEarlier rLater n s t →
    FiniteExtension D X Y f rLater n s t x y
lean.docstring:
本文待证工具（原 am7）：保留 λ 层数的有限页 stretching 充分条件。
参考 MainPaper Proposition `prop:dec738d3` 中同一有限商内的修正过程。
源、靶须属于后页所需的 cycle 层；排除的障碍是在早页同一个有限商中，
源不属于后页 ρ 的 E∞ 像、目标非零的实际较短扩张（包括非 essential 的扩张）。
不能改为只排除较小商中的无层扩张：乘 λ 可能杀掉低滤过项。
这比只排除 essential crossings 更强，不声称等价于原跨页候选或印出的推论。
原仓库已证明有限滤过修正；当前迁移状态另行追踪，不将迁移缺口认定为新假设。
结论只给出后页 extension 的存在，不声称任意指定的早期严格解可提升，
也不蕴含相容解塔或未截断 extension 的存在。

blocks.title: Synthetic boundary maps and their labels

blocks.label: sem:ProofTools:synthetic-boundary-labels
blocks.title: Synthetic boundary maps and weighted labels
blocks.body:
For $n>0$, the absolute connecting map of the quotient triangle is
\[\delta_n:
u X/\lambda^n\longrightarrow\Sigma^{1,-n}
u X.\]
For $0<n<m$, its finite version has target $\Sigma^{1,-n}(
u X/\lambda^{m-n})$. Using the suspension isomorphism of the quotient triangle, the source label of $x$ is $\lambda^a x$ in the $n$-th quotient. For a classical differential of length $r=k+1$ and $n\leq a+k$, its target label is the shifted $\lambda^{a+k-n}y$; the finite label is its image under the target quotient projection. A crossing of the absolute boundary on page $p$ is an essential extension in that same boundary ESS, with source filtration $u$ and target filtration $v$ satisfying $s<u\leq v\leq s+r$.

blocks.label: sem:ProofTools:crossing-ranges
blocks.title: Higher-source extension ranges
blocks.body: Let $f$ be a map of convergent towers or filtered abelian groups. An extension from source filtration $s$ to target filtration $s+n$ has no higher-source crossing over $[u,s+n]$ if every extension with source filtration greater than $s$ and target filtration in $[u,s+n]$ has zero target label. All extensions, including inessential ones, occur in this quantification.

blocks.label: sem:ProofTools:representative-criterion
blocks.title: The full representative criterion
blocks.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Prop. 2.10.)\par{}

Fix a map of convergent towers and an extension equation of length $n$ from $x$ to $y$ in filtrations $s$ and $s+n$, and a threshold $u\leq s+n$. Absence of higher-source extensions whose target lies between $u$ and $s+n$ is equivalent to the following condition: every representative $a$ of $x$ whose image has filtration at least $u$ has image representing the specified $y$ in filtration $s+n$. For threshold $u=s$, the image-filtration premise is automatic. If $y=0$, the conclusion says that every such image has filtration at least $s+n+1$. A map increasing every filtration by at least $n$ satisfies this criterion. The same assertions hold for a homomorphism of abelian groups with decreasing filtrations, using representatives of the given associated-graded source class.

lean.name: KIP126.ProofTools.Paper.filtered_extension_noCrossing_iff
lean.code:
public theorem filtered_extension_noCrossing_iff (f : A →+ B)
    (F : ℤ → AddSubgroup A) (G : ℤ → AddSubgroup B)
    (hF : Antitone F) (hG : Antitone G)
    (hf : ∀ u a, a ∈ F u → f a ∈ G u)
    (s n : ℤ) (hn : 0 ≤ n) (a0 : A)
    (ha0 : a0 ∈ F s) (hfa0 : f a0 ∈ G (s+n)) :
    FilteredNoCrossingRange f F G s n s ↔
      ∀ a : A, a ∈ F s → a-a0 ∈ F (s+1) →
        f a ∈ G (s+n) ∧ f a-f a0 ∈ G (s+n+1) := by
  have h := filtered_extension_noCrossingRange_iff f F G hF hG hf s n s (by omega) a0 ha0 hfa0
  constructor
  · intro hc a ha hd
    exact h.mp hc a ha hd (hf s a ha)
  · intro hall
    exact h.mpr (fun a ha hd _ => hall a ha hd)

    (hf : ∀ u a, a ∈ F u → f a ∈ G u)

    (ha0 : a0 ∈ F s) (hfa0 : f a0 ∈ G (s+n)) :

      ∀ a : A, a ∈ F s → a-a0 ∈ F (s+1) →
        f a ∈ G (s+n) ∧ f a-f a0 ∈ G (s+n+1)

lean.name: KIP126.ProofTools.Paper.filtered_extension_noCrossingRange_iff
lean.code:
public theorem filtered_extension_noCrossingRange_iff (f : A →+ B)
    (F : ℤ → AddSubgroup A) (G : ℤ → AddSubgroup B)
    (hF : Antitone F) (hG : Antitone G)
    (hf : ∀ u a, a ∈ F u → f a ∈ G u)
    (s n threshold : ℤ) (ht : threshold ≤ s+n)
    (a0 : A) (ha0 : a0 ∈ F s) (hfa0 : f a0 ∈ G (s+n)) :
    FilteredNoCrossingRange f F G s n threshold ↔
      ∀ a : A, a ∈ F s → a-a0 ∈ F (s+1) → f a ∈ G threshold →
        f a ∈ G (s+n) ∧ f a-f a0 ∈ G (s+n+1) := by
  constructor
  · intro hc a _ hd hfa
    have hh := filtered_correction_in_next f F G hG hf s n threshold ht hc
      (a-a0) hd (by rw [map_sub]; exact (G threshold).sub_mem hfa (hG ht hfa0))
    have hdiff : f a-f a0 ∈ G (s+n+1) := by simpa only [map_sub] using hh
    refine ⟨?_,hdiff⟩
    have h := (G (s+n)).add_mem (hG (show s+n ≤ s+n+1 by omega) hdiff) hfa0
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using h
  · intro hall u v hsu huv htv hvs a ha hfa
    have ha' : a ∈ F (s+1) := hF (by omega) ha
    have hsum : a0+a ∈ F s := (F s).add_mem ha0 (hF (by omega) ha)
    have hdiff : a0+a-a0 ∈ F (s+1) := by simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using ha'
    have hsumf : f (a0+a) ∈ G threshold := by
      rw [map_add]
      exact (G threshold).add_mem (hG ht hfa0) (hG htv hfa)
    have hh := (hall (a0+a) hsum hdiff hsumf).2
    have hh' : f a ∈ G (s+n+1) := by simpa only [map_add,add_sub_cancel_left] using hh
    exact hG (by omega) hh'

    (F : ℤ → AddSubgroup A) (G : ℤ → AddSubgroup B)
    (hF : Antitone F) (hG : Antitone G)
    (hf : ∀ u a, a ∈ F u → f a ∈ G u)
    (s n threshold : ℤ) (ht : threshold ≤ s+n)
    (a0 : A) (ha0 : a0 ∈ F s) (hfa0 : f a0 ∈ G (s+n)) :
    FilteredNoCrossingRange f F G s n threshold ↔
      ∀ a : A, a ∈ F s → a-a0 ∈ F (s+1) → f a ∈ G threshold →
        f a ∈ G (s+n) ∧ f a-f a0 ∈ G (s+n+1)

Proposition 2.10 for arbitrary filtered abelian groups.  Equality of source
labels is a-a0 ∈ F^(s+1); equality of target labels is f(a)-f(a0) ∈ G^(s+n+1).
Thus this formulation applies to classical homotopy groups as well as to the
synthetic representative version above.  a0 is a witness of the given extension.

lean.code:
public theorem extension_noCrossingRange_iff
    (M : ConvergentMap E g cx.toConvergence cy.toConvergence)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s n threshold : ℤ) (hthreshold : threshold ≤ s+n)
    (x : ((E.obj X).sequence.ssData (s,p.1+s,p.2)).eInfty)
    (y : ((E.obj Y).sequence.ssData (s+n,p.1+(s+n),p.2)).eInfty)
    (he : TowerExtensionEquation M p s n x y) :
    ExtensionNoCrossingRange M p s n threshold ↔
      ∀ a : BiHom p.1 p.2 X, RepresentsInfinityClass cx p s x a →
        a ≫ g ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule Y threshold p →
        RepresentsInfinityClass cy p (s+n) y (a ≫ g) := by
  obtain ⟨hn,ar₀,br₀,he₀,hx₀,hy₀⟩ := (tower_extension_iff M p s n x y).mp he
  let a₀ : BiHom p.1 p.2 X := ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar₀
  let b₀ : BiHom p.1 p.2 Y := ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p).arrow br₀

public theorem extension_noCrossing_of_filtration_bound
    (M : ConvergentMap E g cx.toConvergence cy.toConvergence)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s n : ℤ)
    (x : ((E.obj X).sequence.ssData (s,p.1+s,p.2)).eInfty)
    (y : ((E.obj Y).sequence.ssData (s+n,p.1+(s+n),p.2)).eInfty)
    (he : TowerExtensionEquation M p s n x y)
    (hmap : ∀ k : ℤ, ∀ a : BiHom p.1 p.2 X,
      a ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule X k p →
      a ≫ g ∈ P.filtrationSubmodule Y (k+n) p) :
    ExtensionNoCrossingRange M p s n s := by
  apply (extension_noCrossing_iff M p s n x y he).mpr
  obtain ⟨_,ar₀,br₀,he₀,hx₀,hy₀⟩ := (tower_extension_iff M p s n x y).mp he
  let a₀ : BiHom p.1 p.2 X := ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar₀
  let b₀ : BiHom p.1 p.2 Y := ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p).arrow br₀
  have hx : RepresentsInfinityClass cx p s x a₀ := ⟨ar₀,rfl,hx₀⟩
  have hy : RepresentsInfinityClass cy p (s+n) y b₀ := ⟨br₀,rfl,hy₀⟩
  have hbase : a₀ ≫ g = b₀ := he₀
  intro a ha
  apply represents_of_difference p (s+n) y (a≫g) b₀ hy
  have hdiff := hmap (s+1) (a-a₀) (representatives_difference p s x a a₀ ha hx)
  simpa only [Preadditive.sub_comp,hbase,add_assoc,add_comm,add_left_comm] using hdiff

blocks.body: For $f:X\to Y$ and $x'\in E_2^{s+a,t+a}(X)$, the finite correction label is the image of $\lambda^a x'$ under the shift comparison and quotient isomorphism into the normalized finite source quotient, in synthetic weight $t+e(f)$.

blocks.label: sem:ProofTools:nonliftable-or-crossing
blocks.title: A nonliftable short extension or a late crossing
blocks.body: Consider finite witnesses for the same $f,x,y,n$ on pages $r_{\rm early}\leq r_{\rm late}$. If the late witness is essential and the early one is inessential, then either a shorter early extension retains the original target and has a source in the earlier cycle set but outside the later cycle set, or the same late normalized extension spectral sequence has a nonzero higher-source crossing in the specified range. The first branch uses the actual correction label with $b=0$ and all length and cycle bounds.

lean.name: KIP126.ProofTools.Paper.FiniteExtensionNonliftableShortTo
lean.code:
@[expose] public def FiniteExtensionNonliftableShortTo (X Y : ClassicalObject)
    (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary)
    (rEarlier rLater : ℕ) (n s t : ℤ) (x y)
    (Wearly : FiniteExtensionWitness model X Y f rEarlier n s t x y) : Prop :=
  ∃ a : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ (a:ℤ) ≤ n-normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f ∧
    ∃ x' : Ambient model X (s+a,(t-s)+(s+a)),
      x' ∈ cycles model X (((rEarlier-1:ℕ):ℤ)-a) (s+a,(t-s)+(s+a)) ∧
      x' ∉ cycles model X (((rLater-1:ℕ):ℤ)-a) (s+a,(t-s)+(s+a)) ∧

public theorem finiteExtension_nonliftableShort_or_lateCrossing (X Y : ClassicalObject)
    (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary)
    (rEarlier rLater : ℕ) (n s t : ℤ) (x y)
    (Wlater : FiniteExtensionWitness model X Y f rLater n s t x y)
    (Wearly : FiniteExtensionWitness model X Y f rEarlier n s t x y)
    (hle : rEarlier ≤ rLater) (hess : Wlater.Essential) (hne : ¬Wearly.Essential) :
    FiniteExtensionNonliftableShortTo X Y f rEarlier rLater n s t x y Wearly ∨
      ¬ ExtensionNoCrossingRange (model.convergentMap
        (.quotient (rLater-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
        (.quotient (rLater-1) (.nu Y)) (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (rLater-1)))
        (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) s n s := by
  classical
  by_cases hc : ExtensionNoCrossingRange (model.convergentMap
      (.quotient (rLater-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.quotient (rLater-1) (.nu Y)) (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (rLater-1)))
      (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) s n s
  · have hy := earlier_target_nonzero X Y f rEarlier rLater n s t x y Wlater Wearly hle hess
    obtain ⟨a,ha,han,x',hx',z,hz,hs⟩ := finiteExtension_essential_shorter_source
      X Y f rEarlier n s t x y Wearly hy hne
    by_cases hxl : x'∈cycles model X (((rLater-1:ℕ):ℤ)-a) (s+a,(t-s)+(s+a))
    · have hi : 0<rEarlier-1 := by have := Wearly.page_ge_two; omega
      have haq : a<rEarlier-1 := by have := Wearly.length_upper; omega
      obtain ⟨zl,hzl⟩ := correction_source_lift_of_late_cycle X Y f
        (rEarlier-1) (rLater-1) hi (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hle 1) s t a haq x' hxl z hz
      apply False.elim
      exact essential_short_source_not_in_range
        (.quotient (rLater-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
        (.quotient (rLater-1) (.nu Y))
        (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
        (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (.nu Y))
        (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (rLater-1))
        (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (rEarlier-1))
        ((model.quotients.tower ((extensionSourceObject model X Y f).obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).rho
          (rEarlier-1) (rLater-1) (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hle 1))
        ((model.quotients.tower (model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary))).rho
          (rEarlier-1) (rLater-1) (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hle 1))
        ((model.quotients.natural (model.normalizedMap X Y f).map).rho_naturality
          (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hle 1))
        (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) s n (s+a) (n-a)

    · exact Or.inl ⟨a,ha,han,x',hx',hxl,z,hz,hs.1⟩
  · exact Or.inr hc

blocks.label: paper:2.7
blocks.title: Crossings of extensions
blocks.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Definition 2.7.)
                          

\begin{enumerate}
    \item[(1)] For $x\in E_\infty^{s,t}(X)$, we say that the an $f$-extension $d_n^{f}(x)=y$ has a crossing that hits Adams filtration $p$ for some $p \leq s+n$, if there exists an element $x^\prime\in E_\infty^{s+a,t+a}(X)$ with $a>0$ and an $f$-extension $d_m^{f}(x^\prime)=y^\prime$ for $0\neq y^\prime\in E^{s+a+m, t+a+m}_\infty(Y)$ such that
    $$p = \textup{AF}(y^\prime) = s+a+m\le \textup{AF}(y) = s+n.$$
    \item[(2)] We say that an $f$-extension $d_n^{f}(x)=y$ has no crossing that hits the range AF $\ge p$ if there does not exist an element $x^\prime\in E_\infty^{s+a,t+a}(X)$ with $a>0$ and an $f$-extension $d_m^{f}(x^\prime)=y^\prime$ for $0\neq y^\prime\in E^{s+a+m, t+a+m}_\infty(Y)$ such that
    $$p\le \textup{AF}(y^\prime) = s+a+m\le \textup{AF}(y) = s+n.$$
    \item[(3)] We say that an $f$-extension $d_n^{f}(x)=y$ has no crossing if it has no crossing that hits the range AF$\ge \AF(x) + 1$.
\end{enumerate}

blocks.label: paper:2.10
blocks.title: Characterization of extensions without crossings
blocks.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Proposition 2.10.)
                          

    An $f$-extension from $x$ to $y$ has no crossing in the range $\AF\ge p$ if and only if for all $[x]\in \{x\}$ such that $\AF(f[x])\ge p$ we have $f[x]\in \{y\}$. In particular, we have
    \begin{enumerate}
        \item[(1)] An $f$-extension from $x$ to $y$ has no crossing if and only if for all $[x]\in \{x\}$ we have $f[x]\in \{y\}$.
        \item[(2)] An $f$-extension $d_n^{f}(x)=0$ has no crossing if and only if for all $[x]\in \{x\}$,
        $$\AF(f[x]) >\AF(x)+n.$$
        \item[(3)] If $\AF(f)=n$, then all $d^f_n$-differentials have no crossing in the $f$-ESS.
    \end{enumerate}

lean.code:
public theorem filtered_extension_noCrossing_iff (f : A →+ B)
    (F : ℤ → AddSubgroup A) (G : ℤ → AddSubgroup B)
    (hF : Antitone F) (hG : Antitone G)
    (hf : ∀ u a, a ∈ F u → f a ∈ G u)
    (s n : ℤ) (hn : 0 ≤ n) (a0 : A)
    (ha0 : a0 ∈ F s) (hfa0 : f a0 ∈ G (s+n)) :
    FilteredNoCrossingRange f F G s n s ↔
      ∀ a : A, a ∈ F s → a-a0 ∈ F (s+1) →
        f a ∈ G (s+n) ∧ f a-f a0 ∈ G (s+n+1) := by
  have h := filtered_extension_noCrossingRange_iff f F G hF hG hf s n s (by omega) a0 ha0 hfa0
  constructor
  · intro hc a ha hd
    exact h.mp hc a ha hd (hf s a ha)
  · intro hall
    exact h.mpr (fun a ha hd _ => hall a ha hd)

public theorem filtered_extension_noCrossingRange_iff (f : A →+ B)
    (F : ℤ → AddSubgroup A) (G : ℤ → AddSubgroup B)
    (hF : Antitone F) (hG : Antitone G)
    (hf : ∀ u a, a ∈ F u → f a ∈ G u)
    (s n threshold : ℤ) (ht : threshold ≤ s+n)
    (a0 : A) (ha0 : a0 ∈ F s) (hfa0 : f a0 ∈ G (s+n)) :
    FilteredNoCrossingRange f F G s n threshold ↔
      ∀ a : A, a ∈ F s → a-a0 ∈ F (s+1) → f a ∈ G threshold →
        f a ∈ G (s+n) ∧ f a-f a0 ∈ G (s+n+1) := by
  constructor
  · intro hc a _ hd hfa
    have hh := filtered_correction_in_next f F G hG hf s n threshold ht hc
      (a-a0) hd (by rw [map_sub]; exact (G threshold).sub_mem hfa (hG ht hfa0))
    have hdiff : f a-f a0 ∈ G (s+n+1) := by simpa only [map_sub] using hh
    refine ⟨?_,hdiff⟩
    have h := (G (s+n)).add_mem (hG (show s+n ≤ s+n+1 by omega) hdiff) hfa0
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using h
  · intro hall u v hsu huv htv hvs a ha hfa
    have ha' : a ∈ F (s+1) := hF (by omega) ha
    have hsum : a0+a ∈ F s := (F s).add_mem ha0 (hF (by omega) ha)
    have hdiff : a0+a-a0 ∈ F (s+1) := by simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using ha'
    have hsumf : f (a0+a) ∈ G threshold := by
      rw [map_add]
      exact (G threshold).add_mem (hG ht hfa0) (hG htv hfa)
    have hh := (hall (a0+a) hsum hdiff hsumf).2
    have hh' : f a ∈ G (s+n+1) := by simpa only [map_add,add_sub_cancel_left] using hh
    exact hG (by omega) hh'

blocks.title: The extension theorem for a commutative square
blocks.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Theorem 2.12.)
                          

    Consider a homotopy commutative diagram of spectra
    $$\text{see the original commutative diagram}$$
    Suppose $m,n,l\ge 0$, $0<k\le m+l-n$,
    $$\begin{array}{ll}
        x\in E^{s,t}_\infty(X) & y\in E^{s+n,t+n}_\infty(Y),\\
        z\in E^{s+m,t+m}_\infty(Z) & w\in E^{s+m+l,t+m+l}_\infty(W),
    \end{array}$$
    and
    \begin{enumerate}
        \item[(1)] $d^{f}_{n}(x)=y$,
        \item[(2)] $d^{p}_{m}(x)=z$,
        \item[(3)] the differential in (1) or the differential in (2) has no crossing,
        \item[(4)] $d^{g}_{l}(z)=w$, and has no crossing that hits the range AF $\ge s+n+k$,
        \item[(5)] $d^{q}_{k-1} y=0$, and has no crossing.
    \end{enumerate}
    Then $d^{q}_{m+l-n}(y)=w$. (See Figure \href{paper/main.tex.html#L551}{original source}.)

    {Z W : Syn}

    {f : X ⟶ Y} {h : X ⟶ Z} {j : Z ⟶ W} {k : Y ⟶ W}
    (Mf : ConvergentMap E f cx.toConvergence cy.toConvergence)
    (Mh : ConvergentMap E h cx.toConvergence cz.toConvergence)
    (Mj : ConvergentMap E j cz.toConvergence cw.toConvergence)
    (hcomm : f ≫ k = h ≫ j)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s n m l : ℤ)
    (x : ((E.obj X).sequence.ssData (s,p.1+s,p.2)).eInfty)
    (y : ((E.obj Y).sequence.ssData (s+n,p.1+(s+n),p.2)).eInfty)
    (z : ((E.obj Z).sequence.ssData (s+m,p.1+(s+m),p.2)).eInfty)
    (w : ((E.obj W).sequence.ssData (s+m+l,p.1+(s+m+l),p.2)).eInfty)
    (hf : TowerExtensionEquation Mf p s n x y)
    (hh : TowerExtensionEquation Mh p s m x z)
    (hj : TowerExtensionEquation Mj p (s+m) l z w)
    (hnc : TowerNoCrossing Mf p s n ∨ TowerNoCrossing Mh p s m)
    (hncj : TowerNoCrossing Mj p (s+m) l) :
    ∃ (ar : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration X).F s p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
      (br : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
      (cr : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration Z).F (s+m) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
      (dr : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration W).F (s+m+l) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ)),
      (P.filtration X).toAssociatedGraded s p ar = (infinityGradedIso cx p s).hom x ∧
      (P.filtration Y).toAssociatedGraded (s+n) p br = (infinityGradedIso cy p (s+n)).hom y ∧
      (P.filtration Z).toAssociatedGraded (s+m) p cr = (infinityGradedIso cz p (s+m)).hom z ∧
      (P.filtration W).toAssociatedGraded (s+m+l) p dr = (infinityGradedIso cw p (s+m+l)).hom w ∧
      ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar ≫ f = ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p).arrow br ∧
      ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar ≫ h = ((P.filtration Z).F (s+m) p).arrow cr ∧
      ((P.filtration Z).F (s+m) p).arrow cr ≫ j = ((P.filtration W).F (s+m+l) p).arrow dr ∧
      ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p).arrow br ≫ k = ((P.filtration W).F (s+m+l) p).arrow dr := by
  have hthree : ∃ (ar : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration X).F s p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
      (br : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
      (cr : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration Z).F (s+m) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ)),
      (P.filtration X).toAssociatedGraded s p ar = (infinityGradedIso cx p s).hom x ∧
      (P.filtration Y).toAssociatedGraded (s+n) p br = (infinityGradedIso cy p (s+n)).hom y ∧
      (P.filtration Z).toAssociatedGraded (s+m) p cr = (infinityGradedIso cz p (s+m)).hom z ∧
      ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar ≫ f = ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p).arrow br ∧
      ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar ≫ h = ((P.filtration Z).F (s+m) p).arrow cr := by
    rcases hnc with hnf | hnh
    · obtain ⟨_,ar,cr,he,ha,hc⟩ := (tower_extension_iff Mh p s m x z).mp hh
      obtain ⟨br,he',hb⟩ := tower_target_of_any_source_frame Mf p s n x y hf hnf ar ha
      exact ⟨ar,br,cr,ha,hb,hc,he',he⟩
    · obtain ⟨_,ar,br,he,ha,hb⟩ := (tower_extension_iff Mf p s n x y).mp hf
      obtain ⟨cr,he',hc⟩ := tower_target_of_any_source_frame Mh p s m x z hh hnh ar ha
      exact ⟨ar,br,cr,ha,hb,hc,he,he'⟩
  obtain ⟨ar,br,cr,ha,hb,hc,haf,hah⟩ := hthree
  obtain ⟨dr,hcj,hd⟩ := tower_target_of_any_source_frame Mj p (s+m) l z w hj hncj cr hc
  refine ⟨ar,br,cr,dr,ha,hb,hc,hd,haf,hah,hcj,?_⟩
  rw [←haf,Category.assoc,hcomm,←Category.assoc,hah,hcj]

comments.text:
**Formal scope:** partial.

The private theorem `square\_frames` supplies a commutative four-edge square with synchronized representatives; its conclusion identifies the image along the right edge with the lower-right representative. The present model uses `TowerExtensionEquation` and `TowerNoCrossing` in a convergent synthetic tower. The bridge to the general classical $f$-extension spectral sequence of the paper remains a separate obligation.

Formal counterparts: \item `KIP126.ProofTools.Internal.Leibniz.square\_frames`: [implementation](implementation/index.html#decl:0d629ca12f041ee7)

Original statement and context: paper/main.tex.html#L555; paper/2412.10879.pdf.

blocks.label: paper:2.16
blocks.title: Extensions in a commutative triangle
blocks.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Corollary 2.16.)
                          

    Consider a homotopy commutative diagram of spectra
    $$\text{see the original commutative diagram}$$
    Suppose $n,m\ge 0$, 
    $$x\in E^{s,t}_\infty(X), ~y\in E^{s+n,t+n}_\infty(Y), ~z\in E^{s+m,t+m}_\infty(Z)$$
    and
    \begin{enumerate}
        \item[(1)] $d^{f}_{n}(x)=y$,
        \item[(2)] $d^{p}_{m}(x)=z$,
        \item[(3)] the differential in (1) or the differential in (2) has no crossing.
    \end{enumerate}
    Then $d^{q}_{m-n}(y)=z$.

blocks.label: paper:2.17
blocks.title: Composition of extensions
blocks.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Corollary 2.17.)
                          

    Consider a homotopy commutative diagram of spectra
    $$\text{see the original commutative diagram}$$
    Suppose $n,m\ge 0$, 
    $$x\in E^{s,t}_\infty(X), ~z\in E^{s+m,t+m}_\infty(Y), ~w\in E^{s+m+l,t+m+l}_\infty(W)$$
    and
    \begin{enumerate}
        \item[(1)] $d^{p}_{m}(x)=z$,
        \item[(2)] $d^{g}_{l}(z)=w$, and has no crossing.
    \end{enumerate}
    Then $d^{q}_{m+l}(x)=w$.

blocks.label: paper:2.18
blocks.title: Morphisms of extension spectral sequences
blocks.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Corollary 2.18.)
                          

    Consider a homotopy commutative diagram of spectra
    $$\text{see the original commutative diagram}.$$
    Assume $\ESS{p}_0^{*,*}=\ESS{p}_r^{*,*}$ and $\ESS{q}_0^{*,*}=\ESS{q}_r^{*,*}$ for some $r\ge 0$. Then 
    $$(d^p_r, d^q_r): E_\infty^{*,*}(X)\oplus E_\infty^{*,*}(Y)\to E_\infty^{*,*}(Z)\oplus E_\infty^{*,*}(W)$$
    induces a map from the $f$-ESS to the $g$-ESS.

blocks.label: paper:2.19
blocks.title: Permanent cycles from a null composite
blocks.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Corollary 2.19.)
                          

    If the composition $g\circ f$ of two maps $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y\to Z$ is trivial, and $d_n^f(x)=y$ for $x\in E_\infty^{s,t}(X)$ and $y\in E_\infty^{s+n,t+n}(Y)$, then $y$ is a permanent cycle in the $g$-ESS, i.e., we have
    $d^g_m(y)=0$ for all $m\ge 0$.

blocks.label: paper:2.20
blocks.title: Exactness and extension boundaries
blocks.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Proposition 2.20.)
                          

    Suppose that the sequence of spectra
    $$X\fto{f}Y\fto{g}Z$$
    induces a sequence of homotopy groups
    $$\pi_*X\fto{\pi_*f}\pi_*Y\fto{\pi_*g}\pi_*Z$$
    that is exact in $\pi_*Y$. Then all permanent cycles in $E^{*,*}_\infty(Y)$ of the $g$-ESS are boundaries in the $f$-ESS.

blocks.title: Synthetic boundary maps and extension differentials

blocks.label: paper:4.2
blocks.title: Extensions for $\lambda^n$ and $\rho$
blocks.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Proposition 4.2.)\par
                          
 
The only nonzero differentials in the extension spectral sequences for the maps $\lambda^n$ and $\rho$ from Notation~\href{paper/main.tex.html#L1009}{original source} are the $d_0$'s:
$$d^{\lambda^n}_0=\lambda^n \ \text{and} \ d^{\rho}_0=\rho.$$ 
As a result, these $d_0$'s have no crossings.

lean.docstring:
AimPaper Proposition 4.2 for `0 < n < m < ∞`. The first two clauses
exclude every positive-length essential λ/ρ extension; the last two clauses
identify their length-zero equations with their actual E∞ maps; the final
two clauses exclude crossings of those length-zero equations.
A crossing would require the empty interval `s < u ≤ v ≤ s`.

blocks.label: paper:4.6
blocks.title: Boundary extensions from Adams differentials
blocks.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Proposition 4.6.)\par
                          

    Suppose in the classical Adams spectral sequence of $X$ we have $d_r(x)=y$, where $x\in Z_{r-1}^{s,t}(X)$ and $y\in Z_\infty^{s+r,t+r-1}(X)$. Consider the map
    $$\delta:\nu X/\lambda^n\to \Sus^{1,-n}\nu X/\lambda^{m-n}.$$
    \begin{enumerate}
        \item[(1)] If $r\ge n+1$, then we view $x$ as an element of 
        $$E_\infty^{s,t,t}(\nu X/\lambda^n)\iso Z_n^{s,t}(X),$$
        and $\lambda^{r-n-1} y$ as an element of 
        $$E_\infty^{s+r,t+r-1, t+n}(\nu X/\lambda^{m-n})\iso Z_{m-r+1}^{s+r,t+r-1}(X)/B_{r-n}^{s+r,t+r-1}(X).$$
        We then have
        $$d^{\delta}_r(x)=\lambda^{r-n-1}y,$$
        which is trivial if $r>m$.
        \item[(2)] If $r<n+1$, then we view $\lambda^{n+1-r}x$ as an element of 
        $$E_\infty^{s,t,t-n-1+r}(\nu X/\lambda^n)\iso Z^{s,t}_{r-1}(X)/B^{s,t}_{n+2-r}(X),$$
        and $y$ as an element of 
        $$E_\infty^{s+r,t+r-1, t+r-1}(\nu X)\iso Z_\infty^{s+r,t+r-1}(X).$$
        In this case, we have
        $$d^{\delta}_r(\lambda^{n+1-r}x)=y.$$
    \end{enumerate}

public theorem syntheticDeltaExtension_finite (X : ClassicalObject)
    (n m k a : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (ha : a≤n) (hnm : n<m) (hnk : n≤a+k) (s t : ℤ)
    (x : Ambient model X (s,t)) (y : Ambient model X (s+k+1,t+k))
    (hd : HasDifferential (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))
      (k+1) (s,t) (s+k+1,t+k) x y)
    (hy : y∈permanentCycles model X (s+k+1,t+k)) :
    ∃ ex ey,
      HasInfinityRepresentative _ 2 (s,(t-s)+s,t-a)
        (syntheticDeltaSourceLabel X n s t a x) ex ∧
      HasInfinityRepresentative _ 2 (s+(k+1),(t-s)+(s+(k+1)),t-a)
        (syntheticDeltaFiniteLabel X n m k a s t hnk y) ey ∧
      TowerExtensionEquation (model.convergentMap (.quotient n (.nu X))
        (.shift (1,-(n:ℤ)) (.quotient (m-n) (.nu X)))
        (syntheticFiniteBoundary X n m (by omega) hnm))
        (t-s,t-a) s (k+1) ex ey := by
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hδ⟩ := weighted_absolute_boundary_closed X n k a hn ha hnk s t x y hd hy
  have hb' := detects_transport (show (s,t,t-a)=(s,(t-s)+s,t-a) by simp) _ _ hb
  have hδ' := detects_transport
    (show (s+k+1,t+k,t-a+n)=(s+(k+1),(t-s)-1+(s+(k+1)),t-a+n) by ext <;> dsimp <;> omega)
    _ _ hδ
  have hδ' := boundary_detects_shifted (.nu X) n (t-s) (t-a) (s+(k+1)) b _ (by
    convert hδ' using 1
    simp only [SyntheticObject.obj,regrade_precomp,←Category.assoc,eqToHom_trans])
  let g := (SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,-(n:ℤ))).map
    (XModLambdaN.incl (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) (m-n))
  have hδf := detects_map (.shift (1,-(n:ℤ)) (.nu X))
    (.shift (1,-(n:ℤ)) (.quotient (m-n) (.nu X))) g
    (s+(k+1),(t-s)+(s+(k+1)),t-a) _ _ hδ'
  have heval := finite_boundary_evaluation X n m (by omega) hnm (t-s) (t-a) b
  have hdetection : Detects (model.convergence (.shift (1,-(n:ℤ)) (.quotient (m-n) (.nu X))))
      (s+(k+1),(t-s)+(s+(k+1)),t-a) (syntheticDeltaFiniteLabel X n m k a s t hnk y)
      (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) rfl (b≫syntheticFiniteBoundary X n m (by omega) hnm)) := by
    rw [heval]
    convert hδf using 1
    · rfl
    · simp only [g,syntheticAbsoluteBoundary,absoluteBoundary,Operations.biSuspensionIso,
        SyntheticObject.obj,regrade_precomp,Category.assoc]
  exact extension_equation_of_detected_pair
    (model.convergentMap (.quotient n (.nu X))
      (.shift (1,-(n:ℤ)) (.quotient (m-n) (.nu X)))
      (syntheticFiniteBoundary X n m (by omega) hnm))
    (t-s,t-a) s (k+1) (by omega) _ _ b
    (b≫syntheticFiniteBoundary X n m (by omega) hnm) hb' hdetection rfl

public theorem syntheticDeltaFiniteTarget_vanishes (X : ClassicalObject)
    (n m k a : ℕ) (hnm : n<m) (hout : m≤a+k) (s t : ℤ)
    (e : ((model.family.obj ((SyntheticObject.shift (1,-(n:ℤ))
      (.quotient (m-n) (.nu X))).obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData
      (s+(k+1),(t-s)+(s+(k+1)),t-a)).eInfty) : e=0 := by
  let B : SyntheticObject := .quotient (m-n) (.nu X)
  let δ : ℤ×ℤ := (1,-(n:ℤ))
  let p : ℤ×ℤ := (t-s-1,t-a+n)
  let v := s+(k+1)
  have hzero := finite_infinity_zero_outside X (m-n) (by omega) v (p.1+v) p.2 (by
    dsimp [v,p]
    omega)
  let I := towerInfinityIso (model.convergence B) (model.convergence (.shift δ B))
    ((essShift δ).filtered B p) v
  have hind : (v,(p+δ).1+v,(p+δ).2)=(s+(k+1),(t-s)+(s+(k+1)),t-a) := by
    ext <;> dsimp [v,p,δ] <;> omega
  let J := I ≪≫ eqToIso (congrArg
    (fun j => ((model.family.obj ((SyntheticObject.shift δ B).obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData j).eInfty) hind)
  have hz : IsZero ((model.family.obj ((SyntheticObject.shift δ B).obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData
      (s+(k+1),(t-s)+(s+(k+1)),t-a)).eInfty :=
    hzero.of_iso J.symm
  exact (ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp hz).elim _ _

blocks.label: paper:4.14
blocks.title: Crossings of Adams differentials
blocks.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Definition 4.14.)\par
                          

    Suppose $r\ge n+1$ and $d_r(x)=y$, where
    $$x\in E_2^{s,t}(X), \hspace{0.5cm} y\in E_2^{s+r,t+r-1}(X).$$
    A crossing of $d_r(x)=y$ on the $E_{n+1}$-page refers to an essential Adams differential
    $$d_{r-a-b}(x^\prime)=y^\prime,$$
    where
    $$x^\prime\in E_2^{s+a,t+a}(X), \hspace{.5cm} y^\prime\in E_2^{s+r-b,t+r-b-1}(X),$$
    with $0<a\le n-1$ and $0\le b\le r-n-1$. See Figure \href{paper/main.tex.html#L1211}{original source}.

blocks.label: paper:4.16
blocks.title: Adams crossings and boundary-extension crossings
blocks.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Proposition 4.16.)\par
                          

    The Adams differential $d_r(x)=y$ has a crossing on the $E_{n+1}$-page if and only if the corresponding $\delta_n$-extension
    $$d^{\delta_n}_r(x)=\lambda^{r-n-1}y$$
    for
    $$\delta_{n}:\nu X/\lambda^{n}\to \Sus^{1,-n}\nu X$$
    has a crossing.

lean.name: KIP126.ProofTools.Paper.classical_crossing_iff_delta_crossing
lean.code:
public theorem classical_crossing_iff_delta_crossing
    (X : ClassicalObject) (page : ℕ) (r s t : ℤ)
    (hpage : 2 ≤ page) (hpr : (page:ℤ) ≤ r) :
    HasCrossingOn model X r page (s,t) ↔ DeltaHasCrossing X page r s t := by
  classical
  have hdef : DeltaHasCrossing X page r s t ↔
      ¬TowerNoCrossing (model.convergentMap
        (.quotient (page-1) (.nu X)) (.shift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) (.nu X))
        (absoluteBoundary (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) (page-1)))
        (t-s,t) s r := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨u,v,hu,huv,hv,x,y,hess⟩ hn
      exact hn u v hu huv hv x y
        (by simpa only [Operations.biSuspensionIso,absoluteBoundary] using hess)
    · intro hn
      by_contra hnot
      apply hn
      intro u v hu huv hv x y hess
      apply hnot
      exact ⟨u,v,hu,huv,hv,x,y,
        by simpa only [Operations.biSuspensionIso,absoluteBoundary] using hess⟩
  rw [hdef]
  constructor
  · intro hcross hnc
    exact (delta_no_crossing_implies_classical X page r s t hpage hpr hnc).2.2 hcross
  · intro hcross
    by_contra hnc
    exact hcross (classical_noCrossing_absolute_boundary X page r s t ⟨by omega,hpr,hnc⟩)

    (X : ClassicalObject) (page : ℕ) (r s t : ℤ)
    (hpage : 2 ≤ page) (hpr : (page:ℤ) ≤ r) :
    HasCrossingOn model X r page (s,t) ↔ DeltaHasCrossing X page r s t

blocks.label: paper:5.9
blocks.title: Crossings of $E_r$-extensions
blocks.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Definition 5.9.)\par
                          

    A crossing of the $(f,E_r)$-extension $d_{n}^{f,E_r}(x)=y$ in (\href{paper/main.tex.html#L1305}{original source}) is defined as an essential $(f, E_{r-a})$-extension from some $x'\in Z_{r-1-a}^{s+a,t+a}(X)$ to 
    $$y'\in Z_{r-1-n+b+e(f)}^{s+n-b,t+n-b}(Y)\backslash B_{1+n-b-e(f)}^{s+n-b,t+n-b}(Y)$$
    (where $\backslash$ denotes the difference of sets and it means that $y'$ should survive to the classical Adams $E_{r-n+b+e(f)}$ page while it should not be hit by an Adams differential of length at most $1+n-b-e(f)$) for $0<a \le r-2$ and $0\le b\le n-a-e(f)$. See Figure \href{paper/main.tex.html#L1512}{original source}.

lean.name: KIP126.ProofTools.InfiniteHasCrossing
lean.code:
public def InfiniteHasCrossing
    (n s t : ℤ) : Prop :=
  ∃ a b : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ (a : ℤ) ≤ n - normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f ∧
    (b : ℤ) ≤ n - a - normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f ∧
    ∃ (x' : Ambient D X (s + a, t + a))
      (y' : Ambient D Y
        (s + a + (n - a - b), t + a + (n - a - b))),
      ∃ W' : InfiniteExtensionWitness D X Y f (n - a - b) (s + a) (t + a) x' y',
        W'.Essential ∧ y' ∉ KIP126.Literature.boundaries D Y
          (1 + n - b - normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f)
          (s + a + (n - a - b), t + a + (n - a - b))

The infinite clause uses the same untruncated normalized map and actual
permanent representatives. The bound a≤n-e follows from the length range,
and is recorded explicitly; there is no finite-page upper bound on a.

blocks.label: paper:5.10
blocks.title: Crossings of $E_r$-extensions and synthetic extensions
blocks.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Proposition 5.10.)\par
                          

    An $(f,E_r)$-extension $d_{n}^{f,E_r}(x)=y$ (\href{paper/main.tex.html#L1305}{original source}) has a crossing if and only if the synthetic $\hat f_{r-1}$-extension $d_{n}^{\hat f_{r-1}}(x)=\lambda^{n-e(f)} y$ (\href{paper/main.tex.html#L1309}{original source}) has a crossing.

private theorem minimal_length_finite_tower_no_crossing (X Y : ClassicalObject)
    (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (s t n : ℤ) (hn : n ≤ normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) :
    TowerNoCrossing (model.convergentMap
      (.quotient q (extensionSourceObject model X Y f)) (.quotient q (.nu Y))
      (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f q))
      (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) s n := by
  intro u v hs huv hv x y he
  have hh := finite_crossing_target_bound X Y f q hq s t u v hs huv x y he
  omega

private theorem finite_normalized_image_filtration (X Y : ClassicalObject)
    (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary)
    (q i : ℕ) (hi : 0 < i) (hiq : i < q) (s t : ℤ)
    (a : BiHom (t-s) (t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)
      (XModLambdaN ((extensionSourceObject model X Y f).obj model.nu model.auxiliary) q))
    (ha : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (s+i) a) :
    FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (s+i+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)
      (a≫finiteExtensionMap model X Y f q) := by
  let e : ℤ := normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f
  let A := (extensionSourceObject model X Y f).obj model.nu model.auxiliary
  let B := model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary)
  let F := SyntheticCategory.biShift (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (0,-(i:ℤ))
  let Ta := (model.quotients.tower A).triangle hi hiq
  let Tb := (model.quotients.tower B).triangle hi hiq
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := normalized_finite_source_division X e i q hi hiq (t-s) (t+e) (s+i)
    (by omega) a ha
  let c := b≫F.map (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (q-i))
  have hc : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (s+i+e) c := by
    have h := shifted_quotient_bottom_filtration Y (q-i) (by omega) (-(i:ℤ)) (t-s) (t+e) c
    convert h using 1; omega
  have hcomm := (model.quotients.natural (model.normalizedMap X Y f).map).lambda_naturality hi hiq
  change F.map (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (q-i))≫Tb.lambdaMap =
    Ta.lambdaMap≫finiteExtensionMap model X Y f q at hcomm
  change b≫Ta.lambdaMap=a at hb
  have he : c≫Tb.lambdaMap=a≫finiteExtensionMap model X Y f q := by
    dsimp only [c]
    rw [Category.assoc,hcomm,←Category.assoc,hb]
  rw [←he]
  exact map_preserves_filtration (model.convergentMap (.shift (0,-(i:ℤ)) (.quotient (q-i) (.nu Y)))
    (.quotient q (.nu Y)) Tb.lambdaMap) (t-s,t+e) (s+i+e) c hc

blocks.label: paper:5.14
blocks.title: From infinity-page extensions to homotopy extensions
blocks.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Proposition 5.14.)\par
                          
Consider $f: X\to Y$, $x\in Z_\infty^{s,t}(X)$ and $y\in Z_\infty^{s+n,t+n}(Y)$.
    Then
    $$d^{f,E_\infty}_n(x)=y$$
    implies that
    $$d^{f}_n(x+B_\infty^{s,t}(X))=y+B_\infty^{s,t}(Y).$$

blocks.label: paper:6.1
blocks.title: The generalized Leibniz rule
blocks.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Theorem 6.1.)\par
                          
[Generalized Leibniz Rule]
    Let $f: X\to Y$ be a map between two classical spectra.
    Suppose that $2\le n\le r$, $e(f)\le m\le n-2+e(f)$, $l\ge e(f)$, and we have
    $$x\in Z_{r-1}^{s,t}(X), \hspace{0.5cm} y\in Z_{r-1-m+e(f)}^{s+m,t+m}(Y)$$
    $$x_\infty\in Z_\infty^{s+r,t+r-1}(X), \hspace{0.5cm} y_\infty\in Z_\infty^{s+r+l,t+r+l-1}(Y)$$
    and the following conditions hold:
    \begin{enumerate}
        \item[(1)] $d_{r}(x)=x_\infty$,
        \item[(2)] $d_{m}^{f,E_n}(x)=y$,
        \item[(3)] $d_{l}^{f,E_\infty}(x_\infty)=y_\infty$,
        \item[(4)] the differential in (1) has no crossing on the $E_n$-page or (2) has no crossing.
        \item[(5)] the differential in (3) has no crossing.                         
    \end{enumerate}
    Then we have an Adams differential
    $$d_{r+l-m}(y)= y_\infty.$$

lean.code:
public theorem generalizedLeibniz
    (X Y : ClassicalObject) (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary) :
    GeneralizedLeibnizLaw model X Y f := by
  intro page r m l s t x y xInfinity yInfinity hpage hpr hm hmUpper hl
    hx hy hxInfinity hyInfinity hdx hf hfInfinity hsourceCrossing htargetCrossing
  let WFinite := Classical.choice hf
  let WInfinity := Classical.choice hfInfinity
  let LeftEdge : Prop := TowerExtensionEquation
    (model.convergentMap (.quotient (page-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.shift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (Internal.Leibniz.absoluteBoundary
        ((extensionSourceObject model X Y f).obj model.nu model.auxiliary) (page-1)))
    (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) s r WFinite.source
    (Internal.Leibniz.glBottomSource X Y f page r l s t hpage hpr WInfinity)
  let SourceNoCrossing : Prop :=
    Internal.Leibniz.TowerNoCrossing (model.convergentMap
      (.quotient (page-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.shift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (Internal.Leibniz.absoluteBoundary
        ((extensionSourceObject model X Y f).obj model.nu model.auxiliary) (page-1)))
      (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) s r ∨
    Internal.Leibniz.TowerNoCrossing (model.convergentMap
      (.quotient (page-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.quotient (page-1) (.nu Y)) (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (page-1)))
      (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) s m
  let BottomNoCrossing : Prop := Internal.Leibniz.TowerNoCrossing
    (model.convergentMap
      (.shift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.shift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) (.nu Y))
      ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ))).map (model.normalizedMap X Y f).map))
    (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) (s+r) l
  have hsourceReady : SourceNoCrossing ∨ FiniteNoCrossing model X Y f page m s t := by
    rcases hsourceCrossing with hδcross | hfcross
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl
        (Internal.Leibniz.classical_noCrossing_shifted_absolute_boundary X page
          (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) r s t hδcross))
    · by_cases hmmin : m ≤ normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr
          (Internal.Leibniz.minimal_length_finite_tower_no_crossing X Y f
            (page-1) (by omega) s t m hmmin))
      · exact Or.inr hfcross
  have boundary_regrade (m0 m1 w0 w1 : ℤ) (hm0 : m0=m1) (hw0 : w0=w1)
      (a0 : BiHom m0 w0 (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary)) (page-1))) :
      Internal.Mahowald.biSuspensionHomEquiv m1 w1 (page-1:ℕ) _
        (homotopyRegrade hm0 hw0 a0 ≫ XModLambdaN.proj _ (page-1)) =
      homotopyRegrade (congrArg (fun z => z-1) hm0) (congrArg (fun z : ℤ => z+((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) hw0)
        (Internal.Mahowald.biSuspensionHomEquiv m0 w0 (page-1:ℕ) _
          (a0 ≫ XModLambdaN.proj _ (page-1))) := by
    subst m1; subst w1; rfl
  obtain ⟨hbottom,hbottomSource,hbottomTarget⟩ :=
    Internal.Leibniz.infinite_extension_lambda_boundary_shift X Y f
      (r-page).toNat (page-1) l (s+r) (t+r-1) xInfinity yInfinity WInfinity
  have hbottomPoint := Internal.Leibniz.gl_bottom_point page r s t
    (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) hpage hpr
  have hR : 2 ≤ r + l - m := by omega
  have hy_later : IsCycle model Y (r + l - m - 1)
      (s + m, t + m) y := by
    by_cases hlmin : l = (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f : ℤ)
    · convert hy using 1
      omega
  -- … (truncated)

blocks.label: paper:6.12
blocks.title: The generalized Mahowald trick
blocks.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Theorem 6.12.)\par
                          
[Generalized Mahowald Trick] 
    Consider a distinguished triangle of spectra
    $$X\fto{f} Y\fto{g} Z\fto{h} \Sus X$$
    with $e(f)+e(g)+e(h)=1$.
    Suppose that $r=n+m+l$, $n_1=n-e(f)\ge 1$, $m_1=m-e(g)\ge 0$, $l_1=l-e(h)\ge 0$, and
    $$\begin{array}{ll}
        x\in Z_{n_1}^{s+l,t+l-1}(X), & y\in Z_{m_1+1}^{s+n+l,t+n+l-1}(Y),\\
        \bar x\in Z_{r-1}^{s,t}(Z), & \bar y\in Z_\infty^{s+r,t+r-1}(Z),
    \end{array}$$
    such that
    \begin{enumerate}
        \item[(1)] $d^{h,E_{r'}}_{l}\bar x=x$, where $r'=r-m_1=n_1+l_1+1$,
        \item[(2)] $d_r \bar x=\bar y$,
            \item[(3)] the $(h,E_{r'})$-extension in (1) has no crossing, or the Adams differential (2) has no crossing on the $E_{r'}$-page,
        \item[(4)] $d^{g,E_{m_1+2}}_{m}y=\bar y$.
    \end{enumerate}
    Then we have $x\in Z_{n+m+e(h)}^{s+l,t+l-1}(X)$ and
    $$d^{f,E_{n+m+1+e(h)}}_{n}x\equiv y \mod B_{r'}^{s+n+l,t+n+l-1}(Y).$$
    (See Figure \href{paper/main.tex.html#L1845}{original source}.)

public def GeneralizedMahowaldLaw (T : TriangleData D.auxiliary) : Prop :=
  ∀ he : (normalizedExponent D.classicalTower T.f : ℤ) + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower T.g +
      normalizedExponent D.classicalTower T.h = 1,
  KIP126.Literature.NormalizedTriangleCompatible D T he →
  ∀ (n m l s t : ℤ),
    let r := n + m + l
    let n₁ := n - normalizedExponent D.classicalTower T.f
    let m₁ := m - normalizedExponent D.classicalTower T.g
    let l₁ := l - normalizedExponent D.classicalTower T.h
    let r' := r - m₁
    ∀ (x : Ambient D (T.X) (s + l, t + l - 1))
      (y : Ambient D (T.Y) (s + l + n, t + l - 1 + n))
      (xBar : Ambient D (T.Z) (s, t))
      (yBar : Ambient D (T.Z) (s + l + n + m, t + l - 1 + n + m))
      (suspendedX : Ambient D (.shift 1 T.X) (s + l, t + l)),
      1 ≤ n₁ → 0 ≤ m₁ → 0 ≤ l₁ →
      IsCycle D (T.X) n₁ (s + l, t + l - 1) x →
      IsCycle D (T.Y) (m₁ + 1) (s + l + n, t + l - 1 + n) y →
      IsCycle D (T.Z) (r - 1) (s, t) xBar →
      IsPermanent D (T.Z) (s + l + n + m, t + l - 1 + n + m) yBar →
      (D.classicalSuspension T.X).DesuspendsClass (s + l) (t + l) suspendedX x →
      FiniteExtension D T.Z (.shift 1 T.X) T.h r'.toNat l s t xBar suspendedX →
      DifferentialAt D (T.Z) r (s, t)
        (s + l + n + m, t + l - 1 + n + m) xBar yBar →
      (FiniteNoCrossing D T.Z (.shift 1 T.X) T.h r'.toNat l s t ∨
        NoCrossingOn D (T.Z) r r' (s, t)) →
      FiniteExtension D T.Y T.Z T.g (m₁ + 2).toNat m (s + l + n) (t + l - 1 + n) y yBar →
      IsCycle D (T.X) (n + m + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower T.h) (s + l, t + l - 1) x ∧
        ∃ y' : Ambient D (T.Y) (s + l + n, t + l - 1 + n),
          FiniteExtension D T.X T.Y T.f (n + m + 1 + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower T.h).toNat
            n (s + l) (t + l - 1) x y' ∧
          Congruent D (T.Y) r' (s + l + n, t + l - 1 + n) y' y

public theorem generalizedMahowald
    (T : TriangleData model.auxiliary) :
    GeneralizedMahowaldLaw model T := by
  intro he htriangle n m l s t
  dsimp only
  intro x y xBar yBar suspendedX hn hm hl
    hx hy hxBar hyBar hsusp hh hd hcross hg
  let eg : ℤ := normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.g
  let ef : ℤ := normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.f
  let eh : ℤ := normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.h
  let pg : ℕ := (m-eg+2).toNat
  let q : ℕ := pg-1
  let i : ℕ := (n+l+eg-1).toNat
  let Q : ℕ := (n+m+eh).toNat
  let sf : ℤ := s+l
  let tf : ℤ := t+l-1
  have hpg : 2 ≤ pg := by dsimp [pg,eg]; omega
  have hq : 0 < q := by dsimp [q]; omega
  have hqZ : (q:ℤ)=m-eg+1 := by dsimp [q,pg]; omega
  have hi : 0 < i := by dsimp [i,eg,ef,eh] at *; omega
  have hiZ : (i:ℤ)=n+l+eg-1 := by dsimp [i,eg,ef,eh] at *; omega
  have hQ : 0 < Q := by dsimp [Q,eg,ef,eh] at *; omega
  have hQZ : (Q:ℤ)=n+m+eh := by dsimp [Q,eg,ef,eh] at *; omega
  have hn0 : 0 ≤ n := by have := Nat.zero_le (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.f); omega
  have hnf : ef ≤ n := by dsimp [ef]; omega
  let Wg : FiniteExtensionWitness model T.Y T.Z T.g pg m (sf+n) (tf+n) y yBar :=
    Classical.choice hg
  let Zν := model.nu.functor.obj (T.Z.obj model.auxiliary)
  let boundary (aZ : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN Zν i)) :
      BiHom ((tf+n)-(sf+n)) (tf+n+eg) (XModLambdaN Zν q) :=
    homotopyRegrade (by dsimp [tf,sf]; omega) (by dsimp [tf]; omega)
      (biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t (i:ℤ) (XModLambdaN Zν q)
        (by simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] using
          (aZ ≫ ((model.quotients.tower Zν).triangle hi (show i < i + q by omega)).delta)))
  have boundary_representative :
      ∃ aZ : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN Zν i),
        Detects (model.convergence (.quotient i (.nu T.Z))) (s,t,t)
          (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteTargetLabel model T.Z i s t 0 xBar)) aZ ∧
        Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q (.nu T.Z)))
          (sf+n+m,((tf+n)-(sf+n))+(sf+n+m),tf+n+eg)
          (finiteTargetForExtension model T.Y T.Z T.g q m (sf+n) (tf+n) Wg.length_lower yBar)
          (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) rfl (boundary aZ)) ∧
        (NoCrossingOn model T.Z (n+m+l) (n+m+l-(m-eg)) (s,t) →
          ∀ a : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN Zν i),
            Detects (model.convergence (.quotient i (.nu T.Z))) (s,t,t)
              (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteTargetLabel model T.Z i s t 0 xBar)) a →
            boundary a = boundary aZ) := by
    have hmi : eg ≤ m := by dsimp [eg]; omega
    have hxi : xBar ∈ cycles model T.Z (i:ℤ) (s,t) :=
      cycles_antitone model T.Z (s,t) (by omega : (i:ℤ) ≤ n+m+l-1) hxBar.2
    have hxiR : ReachesPage (model.classical.obj (T.Z.obj model.auxiliary)) (i+1) (s,t) xBar :=
      (isCycle_iff_reaches model T.Z (i+1) (by omega) (s,t) xBar).mp
        ⟨by omega, by simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using hxi⟩
    obtain ⟨a0Zero,ha0Zero⟩ := (KIP126.Literature.Standard.bhs_finite_lift T.Z i hi s t xBar).mp hxiR
    let a0 : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN Zν i) :=
      a0Zero ≫ XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app Zν) i
    have ha0first : a0 ≫ (model.quotients.tower Zν).rho 1 i hi =
        firstLabel model T.Z s t xBar ≫
          XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app Zν) 1 := by
      dsimp only [a0]
  -- … (truncated)

blocks.label: paper:6.20
blocks.title: Restriction of extensions to earlier pages
blocks.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Proposition 6.20.)\par
                          

    Suppose that we have an $(f,E_r)$-extension $d^{f,E_r}_n(x)=y$, where $x\in Z_{r-1}^{s,t}(X)$ and $y\in Z_{r-1-n+e(f)}^{s+n,t+n}(Y)$. Then for all $2\le r'<r$, we also have
    \begin{equation}\label{eq:dr'}
        d^{f,E_{r'}}_n(x)=y.\tag{5.4}\end{equation}

    Furthermore, if $d^{f,E_r}_n(x)=y$ is essential and $n\le r'-2+e(f)$, then (\href{paper/main.tex.html#L1983}{original source}) is inessential if and only if there exists some $0<a'\le n-e(f)$ and an element
    $$x'\in Z_{r'-1-a'}^{s+a',t+a'}(X)\backslash Z_{r-1-a'}^{s+a',t+a'}(X)$$
    such that
    $$d^{\hat f_{r'-1}}_{n-a'-b}(\lambda^{a'} x')=\lambda^{n-b-e(f)} y'$$
    for some $b\ge 0$.

public theorem finiteExtension_inessential_iff_shorter (X Y : ClassicalObject)
    (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary)
    (rEarlier rLater : ℕ) (n s t : ℤ) (x y)
    (Wlater : FiniteExtensionWitness model X Y f rLater n s t x y)
    (Wearly : FiniteExtensionWitness model X Y f rEarlier n s t x y)
    (hle : rEarlier ≤ rLater) (hess : Wlater.Essential) :
    ¬ Wearly.Essential ↔ ∃ a : ℕ, 0 < a ∧
      (a:ℤ) ≤ n-normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f ∧
      ∃ x' : Ambient model X (s+a,(t-s)+(s+a)),
        x' ∈ cycles model X (((rEarlier-1:ℕ):ℤ)- (a:ℤ)) (s+a,(t-s)+(s+a)) ∧
        ∃ z,
          HasInfinityRepresentative _ 2 _
            (finiteExtensionCorrectionLabel X Y f (rEarlier-1) s t a x') z ∧
          TowerExtensionEquation (model.convergentMap
            (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
            (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (.nu Y)) (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (rEarlier-1)))
            (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) (s+a) (n-a) z
            ((eqToHom (congrArg (fun d =>
              ((model.family.obj ((SyntheticObject.quotient (rEarlier-1) (.nu Y)).obj
                model.nu model.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData
                (d,(t-s)+d,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)).eInfty)
              (show s+n = (s+a)+(n-a) by omega))) Wearly.target) := by
  let A := (SyntheticObject.quotient (rEarlier-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f)).obj
    model.nu model.auxiliary
  let B := (SyntheticObject.quotient (rEarlier-1) (.nu Y)).obj model.nu model.auxiliary
  let p : ℤ × ℤ := (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)
  let M := model.convergentMap
    (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
    (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (.nu Y)) (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (rEarlier-1))
  have hy := earlier_target_nonzero X Y f rEarlier rLater n s t x y Wlater Wearly hle hess
  constructor
  · intro hne
    have hn := inessential_length_strict X Y f rEarlier n s t x y Wearly hy hne
    have hq : 1 < rEarlier-1 := by have := Wearly.length_upper; omega
    obtain ⟨hn0,ar,br,heq,hbr⟩ :=
      (tower_inessential_iff_higher_source_same_target M p s n
        Wearly.source Wearly.target Wearly.equation).mp hne
    let I := infinityGradedIso (model.convergence
      (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))) p (s+1)
    let z := I.inv ((model.syntheticTower.filtration A).toAssociatedGraded (s+1) p ar)
    obtain ⟨x',hx',hz⟩ := correction_label_exists X Y f (rEarlier-1)
      (by omega) s t 1 hq z
    refine ⟨1,by decide,by omega,x',hx',z,hz,?_⟩
    apply (tower_extension_reindexed M p (s+1) (n-1) (s+n) (by omega) z Wearly.target).mpr
    refine ⟨by omega,ar,br,heq,?_,hbr⟩
    exact (I.toLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply _).symm
  · rintro ⟨a,ha,han,x',hx',z,hz,he⟩
    obtain ⟨_,ar,br,heq,_,hbr⟩ :=
      (tower_extension_reindexed M p (s+a) (n-a) (s+n) (by omega) z Wearly.target).mp he
    have hα : ((model.syntheticTower.filtration A).F (s+a) p).arrow ar ∈
        model.syntheticTower.filtrationSubmodule A (s+a) p := by
      have hm : ((model.syntheticTower.filtration A).F (s+a) p).arrow ar ∈
          ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ ((model.syntheticTower.filtration A).F (s+a) p) := ⟨ar,rfl⟩
      simpa only [SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using hm
    have hα' := model.syntheticTower.filtrationSubmodule_antitone A p
      (show s+1 ≤ s+a by omega) hα
    obtain ⟨ar',har'⟩ := filtration_representative_exists model.syntheticTower A p (s+1)
      (((model.syntheticTower.filtration A).F (s+a) p).arrow ar) hα'
    apply (tower_inessential_iff_higher_source_same_target M p s n
      Wearly.source Wearly.target Wearly.equation).mpr
  -- … (truncated)

public theorem finiteExtension_descends
    (X Y : ClassicalObject) (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary)
    (rEarlier rLater : ℕ) (n s t : ℤ)
    (x : Ambient model X (s,t)) (y : Ambient model Y (s+n,t+n))
    (hr : 2 ≤ rEarlier) (hle : rEarlier ≤ rLater)
    (hnUpper : n ≤ (rEarlier : ℤ) - 2 + normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)
    (h : FiniteExtension model X Y f rLater n s t x y) :
    FiniteExtension model X Y f rEarlier n s t x y := by
  obtain ⟨W⟩ := h
  let ra := (model.quotients.tower
    ((extensionSourceObject model X Y f).obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).rho
      (rEarlier-1) (rLater-1) (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hle 1)
  let rb := (model.quotients.tower (model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary))).rho
    (rEarlier-1) (rLater-1) (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hle 1)
  refine ⟨{
    page_ge_two := hr
    length_lower := W.length_lower
    length_upper := hnUpper
    source_cycle := reaches_earlier (by omega) (by omega) W.source_cycle
    target_cycle := reaches_earlier (by omega) (by omega) W.target_cycle
    source := (model.family.functor.map ra).eInftyMap
      (s,(t-s)+s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) W.source
    target := (model.family.functor.map rb).eInftyMap
      (s+n,(t-s)+(s+n),t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) W.target
    source_rep := ?_
    target_rep := ?_
    equation := ?_ }⟩
  · have hh := family_infinity_representative_map ra _ _ W.source W.source_rep
    rw [finite_source_rho] at hh
    exact hh
  · have hh := family_infinity_representative_map rb _ _ W.target W.target_rep
    rw [finite_target_rho] at hh
    exact hh
  · exact extension_square_map
      (.quotient (rLater-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.quotient (rLater-1) (.nu Y))
      (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (.nu Y))
      (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (rLater-1))
      (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (rEarlier-1)) ra rb
      ((model.quotients.natural (model.normalizedMap X Y f).map).rho_naturality
        (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hle 1))
      (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) s n W.source W.target W.equation
