blocks.label: paper:6.23
blocks.title: Lifting extensions to later pages
blocks.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Corollary 6.23.)\par
                          

    Suppose $r\ge r'$ and there exists an $(f,E_{r'})$-extension 
    $$d^{f,E_{r'}}_n(x)=y$$
    for $x\in Z_{r-1}^{s,t}(X)$ and $y\in Z_{r'-1-n+e(f)}^{s+n,t+n}(Y)$. Assume that this extension has no crossing of the form $d^{f,E_{r'-a}}_{n-a-b}(x')=y'$ for any $b>0$, $0<a\le n-e(f)$, and 
    $$x'\in Z_{r'-1-a}^{s+a,t+a}(X)\backslash Z_{r-1-a}^{s+a,t+a}(X).$$ 
    Under these conditions, we also have an $(f,E_{r})$-extension
    $$d^{f,E_{r}}_n(x)=y.$$

lean.name: KIP126.ProofTools.Standard.finitePageExtensionStretching
lean.code:
public theorem finitePageExtensionStretching
    (X Y : ClassicalObject) (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary) :
    FinitePageExtensionStretchingLaw model X Y f := by
  classical
  intro rEarlier rLater n s t x y hr hle hn hnUpper hx hy hW hcross
  have hn0 : 0 ≤ n := le_trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)) hn
  let p : ℤ × ℤ := (t - s, t + normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)
  let Aearly := (SyntheticObject.quotient (rEarlier - 1)
    (extensionSourceObject model X Y f)).obj model.nu model.auxiliary
  let Alater := (SyntheticObject.quotient (rLater - 1)
    (extensionSourceObject model X Y f)).obj model.nu model.auxiliary
  let Bearly := (SyntheticObject.quotient (rEarlier - 1) (.nu Y)).obj model.nu model.auxiliary
  let E : ℤ → AddSubgroup (BiHom p.1 p.2 Aearly) :=
    fun k => (model.syntheticTower.filtrationSubmodule Aearly k p).toAddSubgroup
  let L : ℤ → AddSubgroup (BiHom p.1 p.2 Alater) :=
    fun k => (model.syntheticTower.filtrationSubmodule Alater k p).toAddSubgroup
  let F : ℤ → AddSubgroup (BiHom p.1 p.2 Bearly) :=
    fun k => (model.syntheticTower.filtrationSubmodule Bearly k p).toAddSubgroup
  let T := F (s + n + 1)
  let ρ : BiHom p.1 p.2 Alater →+ BiHom p.1 p.2 Aearly :=
    (syntheticHomotopyMap
      ((model.quotients.tower ((extensionSourceObject model X Y f).obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).rho
        (rEarlier - 1) (rLater - 1) (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hle 1)) p).hom.toAddMonoidHom
  let g : BiHom p.1 p.2 Aearly →+ BiHom p.1 p.2 Bearly :=
    (syntheticHomotopyMap (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (rEarlier - 1)) p).hom.toAddMonoidHom
  have hL : Antitone L := by
    intro i j hij z hz
    exact model.syntheticTower.filtrationSubmodule_antitone Alater p hij hz
  have actual_map_preserves (A B : SyntheticObject)
      (h : A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary ⟶ B.obj model.nu model.auxiliary) (k : ℤ)
      (z : BiHom p.1 p.2 (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary))
      (hz : z ∈ model.syntheticTower.filtrationSubmodule (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary) k p) :
      z ≫ h ∈ model.syntheticTower.filtrationSubmodule (B.obj model.nu model.auxiliary) k p :=
    map_preserves_filtration (model.convergentMap A B h) p k z hz
  have hg : ∀ k : ℤ, ∀ δ : BiHom p.1 p.2 Aearly, δ ∈ E k → g δ ∈ F k := by
    intro k δ hδ
    exact actual_map_preserves (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (.nu Y)) (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (rEarlier - 1)) k δ hδ
  have hstep : ∀ k : ℤ, s + 1 ≤ k → k < s + 1 + n.toNat →
      ∀ δ : BiHom p.1 p.2 Aearly, δ ∈ E k →
      (∃ ε : BiHom p.1 p.2 Alater, ε ∈ L k ∧ δ - ρ ε ∈ E (k + 1)) ∨ g δ ∈ T := by
    intro k hk hkn δ hδ
    by_cases hlift : ∃ ε : BiHom p.1 p.2 Alater, ε ∈ L k ∧ δ - ρ ε ∈ E (k + 1)
    · exact Or.inl hlift
    right
    by_contra hnot
    have hlast : k + ((s + n + 1 - k).toNat : ℤ) = s + n + 1 := by omega
    obtain ⟨l, hkl, hln, hgl, hgnext⟩ := first_nonzero_filtration_grade F k
      (s + n + 1 - k).toNat (g δ) (hg k δ hδ) (by simpa only [hlast] using hnot)
    apply hcross
    have module_map_zero {A B : ModuleCat ℤ} (f : A ⟶ B) : f (0 : A) = 0 := f.hom.map_zero
    have hln' : l ≤ s + n := by omega
    obtain ⟨a, hka⟩ : ∃ a : ℕ, k = s + a :=
      ⟨(k-s).toNat, by omega⟩
    subst k
    have ha : 0 < a := by omega
    obtain ⟨b, hl⟩ : ∃ b : ℕ, l = s + a + (n-a-b) :=
      ⟨(s+n-l).toNat, by omega⟩
    subst l
    have hab : (a : ℤ) + b ≤ n := by omega
  -- … (truncated)

lean.code:
public def FiniteExtensionNonliftableCrossing
    (rEarlier rLater : ℕ) (n s t : ℤ) : Prop :=
  ∃ hle : rEarlier ≤ rLater, ∃ a b : ℕ,
    0 < a ∧ a ≤ rEarlier - 2 ∧ (a : ℤ) + b ≤ n ∧
    ∃ (source : ((D.family.obj ((SyntheticObject.quotient (rEarlier - 1)
          (extensionSourceObject D X Y f)).obj D.nu D.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData
          (s + a, (t - s) + (s + a), t + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f)).eInfty)
      (target : ((D.family.obj ((SyntheticObject.quotient (rEarlier - 1)
          (.nu Y)).obj D.nu D.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData
          (s + a + (n - a - b), (t - s) + (s + a + (n - a - b)),
            t + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f)).eInfty),
      source ∉ Set.range (((D.family.functor.map
        ((D.quotients.tower ((extensionSourceObject D X Y f).obj D.nu D.auxiliary)).rho
          (rEarlier - 1) (rLater - 1) (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hle 1))).eInftyMap
            (s + a, (t - s) + (s + a), t + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f)).hom) ∧
      TowerExtensionEquation (D.convergentMap
        (.quotient (rEarlier - 1) (extensionSourceObject D X Y f))
        (.quotient (rEarlier - 1) (.nu Y))
        (finiteExtensionMap D X Y f (rEarlier - 1)))
        (t - s, t + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f) (s + a) (n - a - b) source target ∧
      target ≠ 0

lean.docstring:
有限 stretching 的障碍候选，直接在同一个早期 λ 商的实际 ESS 中定义。
源和靶的 synthetic weight 固定为原 extension 的 `t + e(f)`，而源的
filtration 提高 `a`。源必须不在后期商到早期商的实际 `ρ` 所诱导的
`E∞` 映射像中；这与某个普通 Adams 代表元不属于后页 cycle 层不同。
允许 `b = 0` 及长度 `n - a - b = 0` 的 synthetic extension，包括
`e(f) = 1` 的情形。要求同商中实际 extension equation 的靶非零，不要求
essential 性，不换成较小 λ 商的 extension，也不额外施加普通 Adams
boundary 排除条件。排除这些候选强于仅排除 essential crossings；这是
修复后的充分条件，不声称与原普通 Adams 代表元谓词等价。

public def FinitePageExtensionStretchingLaw (X Y : ClassicalObject) (f : X.obj D.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj D.auxiliary) : Prop :=
  ∀ (rEarlier rLater : ℕ) (n s t : ℤ)
    (x : Ambient D X (s, t)) (y : Ambient D Y (s + n, t + n)),
    2 ≤ rEarlier → rEarlier ≤ rLater →
    (normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f : ℤ) ≤ n →
    n ≤ (rEarlier : ℤ) - 2 + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f →
    IsCycle D X ((rLater : ℤ) - 1) (s, t) x →
    IsCycle D Y ((rLater : ℤ) - 1 - n + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f) (s + n, t + n) y →
    FiniteExtension D X Y f rEarlier n s t x y →
    ¬ FiniteExtensionNonliftableCrossing D X Y f rEarlier rLater n s t →
    FiniteExtension D X Y f rLater n s t x y

    (x : Ambient D X (s, t)) (y : Ambient D Y (s + n, t + n)),
    2 ≤ rEarlier → rEarlier ≤ rLater →
    (normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f : ℤ) ≤ n →
    n ≤ (rEarlier : ℤ) - 2 + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f →
    IsCycle D X ((rLater : ℤ) - 1) (s, t) x →

lean.docstring:
本文待证工具（原 am7）：保留 λ 层数的有限页 stretching 充分条件。
参考 MainPaper Proposition `prop:dec738d3` 中同一有限商内的修正过程。
源、靶须属于后页所需的 cycle 层；排除的障碍是在早页同一个有限商中，
源不属于后页 ρ 的 E∞ 像、目标非零的实际较短扩张（包括非 essential 的扩张）。
不能改为只排除较小商中的无层扩张：乘 λ 可能杀掉低滤过项。
这比只排除 essential crossings 更强，不声称等价于原跨页候选或印出的推论。
原仓库已证明有限滤过修正；当前迁移状态另行追踪，不将迁移缺口认定为新假设。
结论只给出后页 extension 的存在，不声称任意指定的早期严格解可提升，
也不蕴含相容解塔或未截断 extension 的存在。

blocks.label: frontier:ProofTools:003e9deb7ec5
blocks.title: Generalized Leibniz and Mahowald laws
blocks.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Theorems 6.1 and 6.12.)\par
Work in the fixed classical and synthetic Adams model.
\begin{enumerate}
\item Let $X,Y$ be classical spectra and $f:X\to Y$, and put $e=e(f)$. For every $p\in\mathbb N$ and $r,m,l,s,t\in\mathbb Z$ with
\[2\leq p\leq r,\qquad e\leq m\leq p-2+e,\qquad e\leq l,\]
let
\[x\in Z_{r-1}^{s,t}(X),\qquad y\in Z_{r-1-m+e}^{s+m,t+m}(Y),\]
\[x_\infty\in Z_\infty^{s+r,t+r-1}(X),\qquad y_\infty\in Z_\infty^{s+r+l,t+r+l-1}(Y).
\]
Suppose that
\[d_r(x)=x_\infty,\qquad d_m^{f,E_p}(x)=y,\qquad d_l^{f,E_\infty}(x_\infty)=y_\infty.
\]
Assume that the first differential has no crossing on page $p$ or that the finite extension has no crossing, and that the infinite extension has no crossing. Then
\[d_{r+l-m}(y)=y_\infty.
\]
Thus the generalized Leibniz law of \ref{sem:ProofTools:leibniz-law} holds for every $X,Y,f$.

\item Let $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ\xrightarrow h\Sigma X$ be a distinguished triangle with
\[e(f)+e(g)+e(h)=1,
\]
and assume that its normalized synthetic maps form a compatible triangle, as in \ref{sem:ProofTools:mahowald-law}. For every $n,m,l,s,t\in\mathbb Z$, put
\[n_1=n-e(f)\geq1,\quad m_1=m-e(g)\geq0,\quad l_1=l-e(h)\geq0,\quad r=n+m+l,\quad r'=r-m_1.
\]
Let
\[x\in Z_{n_1}^{s+l,t+l-1}(X),\qquad y\in Z_{m_1+1}^{s+l+n,t+l+n-1}(Y),\]
\[\bar x\in Z_{r-1}^{s,t}(Z),\qquad\bar y\in Z_\infty^{s+r,t+r-1}(Z).
\]
Let $\widetilde x\in E_2^{s+l,t+l}(\Sigma X)$ desuspend to $x$ under the classical tower suspension comparison. Suppose that
\[d_l^{h,E_{r'}}(\bar x)=\widetilde x,\qquad d_r(\bar x)=\bar y,\qquad d_m^{g,E_{m_1+2}}(y)=\bar y.
\]
Assume that the $h$-extension has no crossing or that the classical differential has no crossing on page $r'$. Then
\[x\in Z_{n+m+e(h)}^{s+l,t+l-1}(X)
\]
and there is $y'\in E_2^{s+l+n,t+l+n-1}(Y)$ such that
\[d_n^{f,E_{n+m+1+e(h)}}(x)=y',\qquad y'-y\in B_{r'}^{s+l+n,t+l+n-1}(Y).
\]
\end{enumerate}

lean.name: KIP126.ProofTools.Standard.generalizedLeibniz
lean.code:
public theorem generalizedLeibniz
    (X Y : ClassicalObject) (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary) :
    GeneralizedLeibnizLaw model X Y f := by
  intro page r m l s t x y xInfinity yInfinity hpage hpr hm hmUpper hl
    hx hy hxInfinity hyInfinity hdx hf hfInfinity hsourceCrossing htargetCrossing
  let WFinite := Classical.choice hf
  let WInfinity := Classical.choice hfInfinity
  let LeftEdge : Prop := TowerExtensionEquation
    (model.convergentMap (.quotient (page-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.shift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (Internal.Leibniz.absoluteBoundary
        ((extensionSourceObject model X Y f).obj model.nu model.auxiliary) (page-1)))
    (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) s r WFinite.source
    (Internal.Leibniz.glBottomSource X Y f page r l s t hpage hpr WInfinity)
  let SourceNoCrossing : Prop :=
    Internal.Leibniz.TowerNoCrossing (model.convergentMap
      (.quotient (page-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.shift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (Internal.Leibniz.absoluteBoundary
        ((extensionSourceObject model X Y f).obj model.nu model.auxiliary) (page-1)))
      (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) s r ∨
    Internal.Leibniz.TowerNoCrossing (model.convergentMap
      (.quotient (page-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.quotient (page-1) (.nu Y)) (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (page-1)))
      (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) s m
  let BottomNoCrossing : Prop := Internal.Leibniz.TowerNoCrossing
    (model.convergentMap
      (.shift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.shift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) (.nu Y))
      ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ))).map (model.normalizedMap X Y f).map))
    (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) (s+r) l
  have hsourceReady : SourceNoCrossing ∨ FiniteNoCrossing model X Y f page m s t := by
    rcases hsourceCrossing with hδcross | hfcross
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl
        (Internal.Leibniz.classical_noCrossing_shifted_absolute_boundary X page
          (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) r s t hδcross))
    · by_cases hmmin : m ≤ normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr
          (Internal.Leibniz.minimal_length_finite_tower_no_crossing X Y f
            (page-1) (by omega) s t m hmmin))
      · exact Or.inr hfcross
  have boundary_regrade (m0 m1 w0 w1 : ℤ) (hm0 : m0=m1) (hw0 : w0=w1)
      (a0 : BiHom m0 w0 (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary)) (page-1))) :
      Internal.Mahowald.biSuspensionHomEquiv m1 w1 (page-1:ℕ) _
        (homotopyRegrade hm0 hw0 a0 ≫ XModLambdaN.proj _ (page-1)) =
      homotopyRegrade (congrArg (fun z => z-1) hm0) (congrArg (fun z : ℤ => z+((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) hw0)
        (Internal.Mahowald.biSuspensionHomEquiv m0 w0 (page-1:ℕ) _
          (a0 ≫ XModLambdaN.proj _ (page-1))) := by
    subst m1; subst w1; rfl
  obtain ⟨hbottom,hbottomSource,hbottomTarget⟩ :=
    Internal.Leibniz.infinite_extension_lambda_boundary_shift X Y f
      (r-page).toNat (page-1) l (s+r) (t+r-1) xInfinity yInfinity WInfinity
  have hbottomPoint := Internal.Leibniz.gl_bottom_point page r s t
    (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) hpage hpr
  have hR : 2 ≤ r + l - m := by omega
  have hy_later : IsCycle model Y (r + l - m - 1)
      (s + m, t + m) y := by
    by_cases hlmin : l = (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f : ℤ)
    · convert hy using 1
      omega
  -- … (truncated)

public theorem generalizedMahowald
    (T : TriangleData model.auxiliary) :
    GeneralizedMahowaldLaw model T := by
  intro he htriangle n m l s t
  dsimp only
  intro x y xBar yBar suspendedX hn hm hl
    hx hy hxBar hyBar hsusp hh hd hcross hg
  let eg : ℤ := normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.g
  let ef : ℤ := normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.f
  let eh : ℤ := normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.h
  let pg : ℕ := (m-eg+2).toNat
  let q : ℕ := pg-1
  let i : ℕ := (n+l+eg-1).toNat
  let Q : ℕ := (n+m+eh).toNat
  let sf : ℤ := s+l
  let tf : ℤ := t+l-1
  have hpg : 2 ≤ pg := by dsimp [pg,eg]; omega
  have hq : 0 < q := by dsimp [q]; omega
  have hqZ : (q:ℤ)=m-eg+1 := by dsimp [q,pg]; omega
  have hi : 0 < i := by dsimp [i,eg,ef,eh] at *; omega
  have hiZ : (i:ℤ)=n+l+eg-1 := by dsimp [i,eg,ef,eh] at *; omega
  have hQ : 0 < Q := by dsimp [Q,eg,ef,eh] at *; omega
  have hQZ : (Q:ℤ)=n+m+eh := by dsimp [Q,eg,ef,eh] at *; omega
  have hn0 : 0 ≤ n := by have := Nat.zero_le (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.f); omega
  have hnf : ef ≤ n := by dsimp [ef]; omega
  let Wg : FiniteExtensionWitness model T.Y T.Z T.g pg m (sf+n) (tf+n) y yBar :=
    Classical.choice hg
  let Zν := model.nu.functor.obj (T.Z.obj model.auxiliary)
  let boundary (aZ : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN Zν i)) :
      BiHom ((tf+n)-(sf+n)) (tf+n+eg) (XModLambdaN Zν q) :=
    homotopyRegrade (by dsimp [tf,sf]; omega) (by dsimp [tf]; omega)
      (biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t (i:ℤ) (XModLambdaN Zν q)
        (by simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] using
          (aZ ≫ ((model.quotients.tower Zν).triangle hi (show i < i + q by omega)).delta)))
  have boundary_representative :
      ∃ aZ : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN Zν i),
        Detects (model.convergence (.quotient i (.nu T.Z))) (s,t,t)
          (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteTargetLabel model T.Z i s t 0 xBar)) aZ ∧
        Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q (.nu T.Z)))
          (sf+n+m,((tf+n)-(sf+n))+(sf+n+m),tf+n+eg)
          (finiteTargetForExtension model T.Y T.Z T.g q m (sf+n) (tf+n) Wg.length_lower yBar)
          (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) rfl (boundary aZ)) ∧
        (NoCrossingOn model T.Z (n+m+l) (n+m+l-(m-eg)) (s,t) →
          ∀ a : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN Zν i),
            Detects (model.convergence (.quotient i (.nu T.Z))) (s,t,t)
              (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteTargetLabel model T.Z i s t 0 xBar)) a →
            boundary a = boundary aZ) := by
    have hmi : eg ≤ m := by dsimp [eg]; omega
    have hxi : xBar ∈ cycles model T.Z (i:ℤ) (s,t) :=
      cycles_antitone model T.Z (s,t) (by omega : (i:ℤ) ≤ n+m+l-1) hxBar.2
    have hxiR : ReachesPage (model.classical.obj (T.Z.obj model.auxiliary)) (i+1) (s,t) xBar :=
      (isCycle_iff_reaches model T.Z (i+1) (by omega) (s,t) xBar).mp
        ⟨by omega, by simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using hxi⟩
    obtain ⟨a0Zero,ha0Zero⟩ := (KIP126.Literature.Standard.bhs_finite_lift T.Z i hi s t xBar).mp hxiR
    let a0 : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN Zν i) :=
      a0Zero ≫ XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app Zν) i
    have ha0first : a0 ≫ (model.quotients.tower Zν).rho 1 i hi =
        firstLabel model T.Z s t xBar ≫
          XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app Zν) 1 := by
      dsimp only [a0]
  -- … (truncated)
